restaurants.name: Kwonsooksoo
restaurants.description:
Led by chef Kwon Woojoong, Kwonsooksoo is a Korean fine-dining restaurant that interprets Korean ingredients and traditional cooking techniques through a contemporary lens. The restaurant makes its own jang and kimchi in-house, with fermentation forming an important foundation of its cuisine. Kwon also focuses on nurturing young chefs as he prepares for “Kwonsooksoo 3.0,” the restaurant’s next chapter in exploring the possibilities of Korean cuisine.
Lunch Course ₩240,000-
Dinner Course ₩380,000-

restaurants.name: Giwakang
restaurants.description:
Giwakang is a Korean fine-dining restaurant that brings together Korean tradition and contemporary sensibilities with a restrained approach. Familiar flavors and techniques are presented in new compositions, as seen in dishes such as dongchimi paired with caviar. Korean ceramics and crafts are incorporated throughout the dining experience, complementing the food and reflecting the restaurant’s minimalist interpretation of Korean aesthetics.
Lunch Course ₩220,000-
Dinner Course ₩360,000-

restaurants.description:
A Flower Blossom on the Rice is a Korean restaurant committed to sustainable gastronomy under the philosophy of “making a better world with good food.” Operated by an agricultural corporation, the restaurant sources ingredients from pesticide-free and organic farms and uses biodynamically grown rice and traditional Korean jang. Its Korean cuisine highlights the natural flavors of vegetables and grains, with vegan options available across its courses.
Vegan Full Course ₩62,000
Vegan Half Course ₩45,000

restaurants.name: La Yeon
restaurants.description:
Set on the 23rd floor of The Shilla Seoul, La Yeon presents refined Korean cuisine built around carefully selected seasonal ingredients from across the country. Its cooking preserves the essential flavors and techniques of Korean cuisine while expressing them with a lighter, contemporary touch, with dishes such as charcoal-grilled hanwoo highlighting the quality of the ingredients. Panoramic views of Namsan, white porcelain and works by Korean ceramic artists create an elegant setting, complemented by attentive and polished service.
Lunch Course ₩250,000-
Dinner Course ₩380,000-

restaurants.name: Restaurant Jueun
restaurants.description:
Drawing inspiration from Korea’s four seasons and traditional seasonal customs, chef Park Jueun presents Korean cuisine through his own understated perspective. The seasonal courses incorporate a variety of jang, connecting the natural flavors of the ingredients with the depth of fermentation. The main course features a generous spread of traditional Korean dishes, bringing together a diverse range of flavors on one table. Pairings of traditional Korean liquors and wine are also available.
Lunch Course ₩180,000-
Dinner Course ₩280,000-

restaurants.description_zh:
主廚 Park Jueun 從韓國的四個季節和傳統季節習俗中汲取靈感，透過自己低調的視角呈現韓國美食。季節性課程融合了各種醬，將食材的天然風味與發酵的深度結合。主菜以豐盛的傳統韓國菜餚為特色，將多種口味匯集在一張桌子上。也提供韓國傳統酒和葡萄酒的搭配。

restaurants.name: Leebukbang
restaurants.description:
Drawing on North Korean recipes and food traditions passed down through his family, chef Choi Ji-hyung reinterprets sundae (Korean blood sausage) and other regional dishes with a contemporary approach. Sundae forms the centerpiece of the course, ranging from traditional preparations to creative variations incorporating different ingredients, alongside seasonal dishes inspired by the cuisine of various regions in North Korea. The wood-centered interior, including a bar counter made from beams and doors salvaged from a century-old hanok, provides a fitting backdrop for his cuisine.
Weekday Lunch Course ₩65,000-
Weekend & Holiday Dinner Course ₩95,000-

restaurants.description_zh:
廚師 Choi Ji-hyung 借鑒朝鮮家族傳承的食譜和飲食傳統，以現代方式重新詮釋聖代（韓國血腸）和其他當地菜餚。聖代是這道菜的核心，從傳統的做法到融合不同食材的創意變體，以及受朝鮮各地區美食啟發的時令菜餚。以木材為中心的室內裝飾，包括用從百年韓屋回收的橫樑和門製成的吧台，為他的美食提供了合適的背景。
平日午餐套餐 ₩65,000-
週末及假日晚餐套餐 ₩95,000-

restaurants.name: Myeon Seoul
restaurants.description:
Following YUN Seoul, chef Kim Doyun opened myeon-seoul as a more casual restaurant dedicated to his house-made noodles. Made without chemical additives, the noodles combine whole wheat with mung beans and soybeans, using a blend of Korean, French and Turkish wheat to achieve the desired flavor and texture. The menu ranges from fresh perilla oil noodles, which highlight the nutty character of the noodles themselves, to goldongmyeon, alongside dishes such as Seoul Duck, available by advance reservation, and crispy pork belly.
Seoul Duck ₩120,000-
Fresh Perilla Oil Noodles (Vegan) ₩14,000-

restaurants.description_zh:
繼 YUN 首爾之後，主廚 Kim Doyun 又開設了 myeon-seoul，這是一家更休閒的餐廳，專門供應自製麵條。這種麵條不含化學添加劑，將全麥與綠豆和大豆結合在一起，使用韓國、法國和土耳其小麥的混合物來達到所需的風味和質地。菜單包括突出麵條本身堅果味的新鮮紫蘇油麵、金東面以及需提前預訂的首爾鴨和脆皮五花肉等菜餚。
首爾鴨 ₩120,000-
鮮紫蘇油面（純素）₩14,000-

restaurants.name: Mingles
restaurants.description:
At Mingles, chef Kang Mingoo moves fluidly between tradition and modernity, drawing on Korean food culture and seasonal ingredients. Western culinary techniques are combined with distinctly Korean elements such as jang, namul and fermentation, while ingredients and seasonings developed in-house add further depth. Traditional dishes including abalone baechuseon and eomandu are also presented in contemporary forms, shaping a distinctive expression of Korean cuisine.
Lunch Course ₩320,000-
Dinner Course ₩420,000-

restaurants.name: Bongraeheon
restaurants.description:
Set within the hanok and gardens of Mayfield Hotel Seoul, Bongraeheon offers a serene setting for traditional Korean royal court cuisine. The hanok was built using traditional techniques by master carpenter Lee Il-gu, who participated in the restoration of Gyeongbokgung Palace. Head chef Lee Geum-hee presents dishes rooted in royal court traditions, including seongnyutang and chilled prawns dressed with Gapyeong pine nut sauce. Gochujang, doenjang and ganjang are made and aged in-house, contributing depth to the clean, balanced flavors of the cuisine.
Lunch Course ₩70,000-
Jin Yeon ₩110,000-

restaurants.description_zh:
Bongraeheon 餐廳位於首爾梅菲爾德酒店的韓屋和花園內，擁有寧靜的環境，供應傳統的韓國宮廷美食。韓屋是由曾參與景福宮修復工程的木匠大師李一求採用傳統技術建造的。主廚李金熙 (Lee Geum-hee) 提供源自宮廷傳統的菜餚，包括聖牛湯和加平松子醬的冰鮮蝦。辣椒醬、大醬和甘醬均在內部製作和陳釀，為菜餚的乾淨、平衡的風味做出了深度貢獻。

restaurants.name: Bicena
restaurants.description:
Located on the 81st floor of Lotte World Tower, Bicena presents a refined interpretation of Korean cuisine centered on jang, kimchi and seasonal ingredients. Chef Jun Kwang-sik draws on regional dishes and labor-intensive traditional preparations that are becoming less common, reinterpreting them through a contemporary lens while preserving their Korean identity. Expansive views of Seoul, an elegant dining room and attentive service complement the experience.
Sancheon Lunch Course ₩170,000-
Guhak Dinner Course ₩280,000-

restaurants.name: Sancho
restaurants.description:
Drawing on seasonal ingredients from across the Korean Peninsula, particularly the Taean Peninsula on the west coast, Sancho specializes in regional Korean cuisine. Its signature dishes include ganjang gejang, roe-filled female crabs marinated in house-made soy sauce, and spicy seasoned female crab. The menu also features gegukji, a regional specialty of Chungcheong Province, offering a broader taste of the ingredients and culinary traditions of Korea’s west coast.
Soy Sauce Marinated Crab ₩55,000-
Spicy Seasoned Female Crab ₩52,000-

Sancho 採用來自朝鮮半島各地（尤其是西海岸的泰安半島）的時令食材，專門提供韓國當地美食。其招牌菜包括 ganjang gejang、用自製醬油醃製的充滿魚子的母蟹和辣味母蟹。菜單還包括忠清道的當地特色菜“gegukji”，提供韓國西海岸的食材和烹飪傳統的更廣泛口味。
醬油蟹 ₩55,000-
辣味母蟹 ₩52,000-

restaurants.name: Seoryung
restaurants.description:
After beginning in Hongcheon and later moving to Ganghwa, Seoryung expanded to Seoul. Run by Lee Kyung-hee and Jeong Jong-mun, the restaurant specializes in Pyeongyang-style naengmyeon. At its Cheongdam location, pure buckwheat noodles are served in a variety of ways, from the signature Seoryung Sunmyeon with Hanwoo broth to bibim and perilla oil variations. Dumplings, pork jowl and Hanwoo sirloin bulgogi are also available.
Seoryung Sunmyeon ₩18,000
Perilla Oil Sunmyeon ₩18,000

restaurants.name: Solbam
restaurants.address_from_list: 2F, Baekyoung Nonhyeon Center, 231, Hakdong-ro, Gangnam-gu, Seoul
restaurants.description:
Chef Eom Tae-jun’s cuisine respects the roots of Korean food while reinterpreting them through a contemporary approach centered on restraint and balance. Seasonal ingredients follow the rhythm of Korea’s four seasons, with combinations such as blue crab and cauliflower or abalone and bamboo shoots offering new expressions of familiar Korean flavors. The experience begins with drinks and snacks in a softly lit drawing room before moving to the main dining room with its open kitchen.
Solbam Course - Variable Price

restaurants.name: Sutimoon
restaurants.description:
Its name combines suti, a North Hamgyong dialect word for charcoal, with “moon,” reflecting Sutimoon’s focus on Korean cuisine centered around charcoal cooking. Seasonal vegetables and other carefully selected ingredients are prepared to preserve their natural flavors, with charcoal adding further depth and texture. Elements drawn from Korean royal cuisine and traditional dining culture are presented in contemporary compositions, while a more concise set menu of Korean dishes is offered at lunch.
Ayeon – The Refined Banquet ₩129,000
Hwayeon – The Flourished Banquet ₩229,000

restaurants.name: Superpan
restaurants.description:
At Superpan, chef Woo Jung-wook gives familiar Korean dishes a contemporary and casual interpretation. Her approach is rooted in memories of the generous meals prepared by her mother, where numerous banchan were each carefully made yet came together in harmony. Drawing freely on ingredients and culinary influences encountered in everyday life, Woo keeps the flavors and sensibilities of Korean cuisine at the core while presenting traditional dishes from her own perspective.
Lunch Set A ₩78,000-
Dinner Set A ₩180,000-

Chef Lee Jun presents what he calls contemporary Seoul cuisine, drawing on Korean traditions and food culture. Its seasonal “Episode” tasting menu explores a new theme each season, combining seasonal ingredients and Korean flavors with contemporary techniques and creative ideas. The understated, kitchen-centered dining room, refined presentation and relaxed service complete the dining experience.

restaurants.name: Onjium
restaurants.description:
Guided by the philosophy of studying the past to create something new, Onjium researches Korean royal court and banga cuisine—the food of noble households—and reinterprets these traditions for contemporary dining. Led by Cho Eun-hee, a certified practitioner of Joseon royal court cuisine, and chef Park Sung-bae, the team builds refined tasting menus by combining a close understanding of traditional recipes with present-day ingredients and techniques. Located near Gyeongbokgung Palace, it brings past and present together through food, craft and design.
Lunch Course ₩200,000-
Dinner Course ₩300,000-

restaurants.name: Woo Lae Oak
restaurants.description:
Established in 1946, Woo Lae Oak is one of Seoul’s longstanding Pyeongyang-style naengmyeon restaurants, with a legacy spanning three generations. Its distinctive broth is made by simmering hanwoo beef shank and seasoning it simply with salt and soy sauce, producing a pronounced beef flavor and savory depth that complements the buckwheat noodles. Another signature is Seoul-style bulgogi, cooked at the table on a traditional domed grill and often enjoyed alongside the naengmyeon.
Pyeongyang-style Naengmyeon ₩18,000-
Spicy Mixed Naengmyeon ₩18,000-

restaurants.description_zh:
Woo Lae Oak 成立於 1946 年，是首爾歷史悠久的平壤風格冷面餐廳之一，已傳承了三個世代。其獨特的肉湯是通過慢火慢燉韓牛牛腱製成的，並用鹽和醬油簡單調味，產生明顯的牛肉風味和鹹味深度，與蕎麥麵相得益彰。另一個招牌菜是首爾風格的烤肉，在餐桌上用傳統的圓頂烤架烹製，通常與冷麵一起享用。

辣什錦冷麵 ₩18,000-

restaurants.name: Yuroc
restaurants.description:
Pairing traditional Korean liquors with seasonal food, Yuroc brings Korea’s dining and drinking culture into a contemporary bar setting. Its seasonal menu draws on historical dishes such as pogye, based on a recipe from the Sangayorok, and gyuasang, a traditional summer delicacy. A wide selection of Korean liquors, particularly cheongju, complements the food. Meaning the pale green of willow leaves in spring, the name Yuroc evokes both the color of clear cheongju and the leisurely tradition of enjoying a drink.
Gyuasang (Cucumber Dumplings) ₩24,000-
Pogye ₩22,000-

restaurants.description_zh:
Yuroc 將傳統韓國酒與時令食品搭配，將韓國的餐飲文化帶入現代酒吧環境中。其季節性菜單借鑒了歷史菜餚，例如基於 Sangayorok 食譜的 pogye 和傳統夏季美食 gyuasang。各種韓國酒，尤其是清州酒，與食物相得益彰。 Yuroc 的意思是春天柳葉的淡綠色，它的名字既讓人想起清澈的清州的顏色，又讓人想起悠閒地喝一杯的傳統。

restaurants.name: Eatanic Garden
restaurants.description:
Led by chef Son Jong-won, Eatanic Garden explores Korean ingredients through in-depth research, bringing new perspectives to native seeds, local produce and seasonal flavors. Inspired by Korea’s 24 seasonal divisions and the changing rhythms of nature, Son combines ingredients at their peak, from shellfish to native varieties of rice, with contemporary culinary techniques. Each dish is accompanied by an illustrated card depicting its key ingredient, offering further insight into the produce and the composition of the dish.
Lunch Course ₩250,000-
Dinner Course ₩370,000-

restaurants.description_zh:

restaurants.name: Jungsik Seoul
restaurants.description:
Led by chef Yim Jungsik, Jungsik pioneered the concept of “New Korean” cuisine and helped bring contemporary Korean dining to a global audience. Familiar elements such as kimbap and gujeolpan are reworked with modern techniques and ideas, as exemplified by its signature truffle kimbap. From savory dishes to its Jeju dolhareubang-inspired dessert, the tasting menu offers a distinctive interpretation of Korean flavors and culture.
Lunch Course ₩200,000-
Dinner Course ₩300,000-

Carefully selected seasonal ingredients and natural seasonings are combined with recipes she has developed over decades. The intimate restaurant offers lunch and dinner tasting menus as well as a private dining experience.

restaurants.name: Hamo
restaurants.description:
Drawing on the culinary traditions of Jinju and western Gyeongsangnam-do, Hamo presents regional Korean dishes with carefully sourced ingredients and restrained seasoning. The menu includes Jinju bibimbap, rooted in the city’s historic banquet culture, as well as heotjesabap and other local specialties. Each year, the restaurant makes its own doenjang and ganjang from homegrown soybeans, using these naturally fermented jang as the foundation of its cooking.
Jinju Bibimbap ₩19,000-
Heotjesabap ₩16,000-

Centered around a hanok originally built as a state guesthouse in 1957, Korea House is a cultural complex dedicated to Korean food and traditional ways of life. Its cuisine draws on royal court and banga cuisine, the food of noble households, offering a traditional dining experience within historic Korean architecture. Traditional performing arts, wedding ceremonies and other cultural programs provide further opportunities to experience Korea’s cultural heritage.

restaurants.description:
Since 1983, Hansung Kalguksu has served Seoul-style dishes influenced by the culinary traditions of Hwanghae Province and Seoul. Its signature kalguksu pairs soft noodles with a deeply flavored beef bone broth, accompanied by longtime favorites such as suyuk (boiled meat slices) and kimchi. With its focus on familiar, time-honored flavors, the restaurant remains a longstanding part of Gangnam’s dining scene.
Kalguksu ₩12,000-

restaurants.name: Hansikgonggan Soban
restaurants.description:
Chef Cho Hee-sook, known for her extensive research into Korean royal court and banga cuisine, works alongside chef Lee Min-jae to bring these traditions into everyday dining. Dishes include seasonal onban, based on the Pyeongyang specialty and topped with seasonal garnishes, and a spicy pork set served with fresh minari and bean sprouts. Together, the two generations of chefs present Korean food with clean, balanced flavors in an approachable format.
Seasonal Onban Set ₩18,000-

restaurants.name: Haenam Cheonilgwan
restaurants.description:
With roots in Cheonil Sikdang, established in Haenam in 1924, Haenam Cheonilgwan preserves the culinary traditions and family recipes of Korea’s southern Jeolla region under owner Lee Hwa-young. Seasonal ingredients and carefully selected seasonings form the basis of generous table settings featuring specialties such as banji kimchi, chili kimchi with freshwater shrimp jeotgal, and tteokgalbi. By preserving dishes, techniques and ingredients that have become less common over time, the restaurant carries a century of Namdo culinary tradition into the present.
Sim Lunch & Weekend Course ₩65,000-
Cheon Dinner & Weekend Course ₩160,000-

With sauces at the heart of his cooking, Chef Kang Minchul incorporates ingredients such as dried bamboo shoots, shiitake mushrooms and seaweed into refined French techniques. The nature-inspired space complements a distinctive dining experience rooted in Seoul.

More than 95% of its vegetables come directly from the farm, with seasonal produce and herbs at the heart of the menu. Awarded a Michelin Green Star, Gigas offers a distinctive approach to sustainable Mediterranean dining in Seoul.

The signature Darobe Pizza won the 2018 Neapolitan Pizza Maker Korea Championship, while the menu also features classic pizzas and pastas.

Meaning “mother of the earth,” its name reflects a focus on the acidity and umami created through natural fermentation. By transforming the flavors and textures of ingredients through fermentation and combining them in both subtle and bold ways, the chef offers a distinctive interpretation of Korea’s deeply rooted fermentation culture.

restaurants.description:
Mosu is Chef Sung Anh’s fine-dining restaurant, where familiar ingredients are transformed through imagination, precision and a highly personal culinary perspective. Muoki is a contemporary fine-dining restaurant where Chef Park Moo-hyun showcases creative combinations and refined techniques. Its dynamic open kitchen adds a theatrical energy to the dining experience, while the tasting menu balances harmonious flavors with unexpected interpretations of familiar ingredients. Dishes combining contrasting flavors and textures, such as beetroot, goat cheese and hazelnut, reveal the chef’s distinctive creativity. Attentive service and memorable desserts complete the experience.

restaurants.name: Borgo Hannam
restaurants.description:
Meaning “village” in Italian, Borgo Hannam offers a relaxed journey through the diverse regional cuisines of Italy. Chef Stefano Di Salvo, whose extensive career includes leading hotel kitchens in Korea, presents contemporary interpretations of authentic Italian flavors, from house-made bread and fresh pasta to main dishes and desserts. Dishes inspired by regional traditions, including a hearty soup rooted in Tuscan fishermen’s cooking, bring together the warmth of Italian cuisine and the sophisticated sensibility of Seoul.

Milanese ₩125,000

Meaning “basket” in Spanish, Cesta brings together fresh seasonal ingredients, charcoal-grilled dishes and wine in one dining experience. Its cooking focuses on drawing out the natural flavors of quality ingredients over charcoal, with steaks at the heart of the menu alongside seafood and a variety of à la carte dishes. An extensive wine selection complements the food, making Cesta a relaxed destination for enjoying the pairing of charcoal-grilled cuisine and wine.

restaurants.name: Alla Prima
restaurants.description:
Alla Prima is a contemporary fine-dining restaurant where Chef Kim Jin-hyuk freely crosses culinary boundaries. True to its name, which refers to creating something spontaneously, the restaurant combines the chef’s foundation in Japanese and Western cuisine with influences from French, Italian and Southeast Asian cooking. Seasonal ingredients retain their natural character while herbs, vegetables and contrasting textures add complexity and variation. The result is a creative yet intuitive tasting experience built on a precise balance of flavor, aroma and texture.

restaurants.name: Zero Complex
restaurants.description:
Zero Complex is Chef Lee Choong-hu’s restaurant, built on the philosophy that “good food begins with good soil” and a deep respect for producers and ingredients. Now in its third chapter after relocating to Dongbinggo-dong, the restaurant draws on more than a decade of experience to present Korean French cuisine inspired by familiar Korean flavors. Working closely with like-minded producers, the chef transforms seasonal ingredients through French techniques into dishes that are creative, refined and concise.
Lunch Course ₩210,000
Dinner Course ₩280,000

restaurants.name: Table for Four
restaurants.description:
Meaning “a table for four,” Table for Four is a European restaurant built around the warmth of family and the value of local ingredients. Chef Kim Sung-woon sources seasonal seafood from his hometown of Taean in Chungcheongnam-do and makes extensive use of vegetables and produce grown by his family. By intervening minimally with exceptional ingredients while applying refined techniques when needed, the chef captures the landscape and seasons of Taean on the plate.
Lunch Course ₩150,000
Dinner Course ₩250,000

restaurants.name: PERIGEE
restaurants.description:
PERIGEE is run by chefs Shin Ga-young and Lim Hong-geun, a husband-and-wife team who creatively connect Korean seasonal ingredients with Italian cuisine through house-made fresh pasta. The restaurant explores distinctive pasta shapes rarely encountered in Korea, including cavatelli, andarinos and pici, pairing their unique textures with ingredients at their seasonal peak. Meaning the point at which an orbiting body is closest to Earth, the name reflects the chefs’ desire to bring guests closer to food and wine.

restaurants.name: PONO BUONO
restaurants.description:
PONO BUONO is an Italian restaurant where Chef Kim Taesung makes extensive use of a wood-fired oven to bring distinctive aromas and textures to his cooking. From bread to lasagna and other dishes, much of the menu is prepared over fire, emphasizing crisp exteriors, chewy textures and smoky depth. The signature PONO Bread can be enjoyed with prosciutto, Tête de Moine cheese, truffle and honey, while the wood-fired ragù lasagna is another highlight. The restaurant’s appeal lies in the chef’s ability to bring precision and character to seemingly simple combinations.

Chefs Choi Hyun-a and Won Jin-hee, who trained at Kanda and Kurogi in Japan, bring the refined sense of seasonality found in Japanese cuisine to their tasting menu. Dishes include somen learned at Kurogi, preparations featuring freshly ground sesame, and warabimochi made with bracken starch, highlighting careful attention to ingredients and technique. Dinner begins simultaneously for all guests, creating an immersive experience as the dishes are prepared and presented throughout the evening.

Chef Shin Kyesook draws on the Qing Dynasty cookbook Suiyuan Shidan to revive historical Chinese dishes for contemporary diners at Gaehyanggak. Traditional techniques shape dishes such as tender Dongpo pork prepared with Shaoxing wine and Eight-Treasure Duck, with an emphasis on clean, balanced flavors. Its exploration of recipes and culinary traditions recorded in historical texts gives Gaehyanggak a distinctive place in Seoul’s Chinese dining scene.

Led by chef Kim Dong-wook, Muni presents seasonal omakase rooted in the traditions of Japanese kaiseki cuisine. Carefully selected ingredients from Korea and Japan are prepared with restraint, with particular attention to seasonality and presentation, while ceramics collected by the chef add another dimension to each course. A certified kikizakeshi sake sommelier, Kim also offers a selection of sake from across Japan to accompany the menu.

They use seasonal produce sourced from local growers, alongside chicken, eggs, rice and vegetables from their family farm in Cheongju, while house-made seasonings and low-waste cooking reflect a careful approach to each ingredient. Rooted in Japanese culinary traditions, Mitou’s cuisine captures the seasons and terroir of Korea in a distinctive way.

Defined by its minimalist white interior and fully open kitchen, HAKUSI offers a modern Japanese dining experience with a close view of the cooking process. Traditional Japanese cuisine forms the foundation, while techniques and ingredients from other culinary traditions are incorporated freely. Dishes such as crispy unagi, first served with sansho and then wrapped with basil in a thin pancake and paired with basil vinegar, illustrate the restaurant’s inventive approach to familiar ingredients.

Its menu goes beyond familiar Thai staples with dishes such as nam tok hed, a salad of charcoal-grilled mushrooms, herbs and toasted rice powder, and Massaman curry layered with cinnamon and roasted vegetables. Cuts such as bone-in pork belly and pork collar are grilled over charcoal on cast-iron plates to highlight their juiciness and rich flavor. Its menu features Nanchukmatdon pork, developed using native Jeju pig breeds, and locally sourced produce in a varied selection of grilled dishes and Korean specialties. restaurants.name: Base is Nice
restaurants.description:
Led by Jang Jin-a, Base is Nice presents Korean-style set meals centered on seasonal vegetables. The menu changes approximately every three to four weeks, following the seasons through vegetable rice dishes, soups and side dishes that highlight a wide range of Korean produce. With respect for both ingredients and people at its core, the restaurant offers an everyday approach to dining where vegetables take center stage.
Crispy Young Radish & Corn Rice ₩23,000-
Grilled Tofu Rice with Red Chili Purée ₩23,000-

restaurants.name: Bium
restaurants.description:
Drawing on his extensive experience in Korean and temple cuisine, chef Kim Dae-chun presents refined tasting menus centered on seasonal vegetables and local ingredients. His cooking avoids the five pungent vegetables and incorporates house-made traditional jang, with a variety of namul and pickles inspired by the theme of earth, water, fire and wind. Bium brings the restraint of temple cuisine and the depth of traditional Korean vegetable cooking into a contemporary dining experience.
Lunch Jisuhwapung ₩160,000-
Dinner Jisuhwapung ₩280,000-

restaurants.name: Sanchon
restaurants.description:
Sanchon presents temple cuisine inspired by the monastic experience of Jeongsan Kim Yeon-sik, highlighting wild greens and seasonal vegetables in their natural form. Its dishes are prepared without chemical additives, reflecting a longstanding effort to research and preserve disappearing temple food traditions. Set in a traditional Korean house filled with Buddhist details, Sanchon offers a tranquil experience of the simplicity and seasonality of Korean temple cuisine.
Jeongsik A Set Menu ₩29,000
Bibimbap ₩18,000

restaurants.description:
Yangchul Seoul approaches vegetables not simply as healthy food, but as flavorful ingredients in their own right. Seasonal vegetables sourced from producers take center stage, with meat and seafood used where appropriate to highlight their diverse flavors and textures. Natural wines accompany the food, while vegetable classes extend the restaurant’s approach to everyday cooking.
Variable Price

Hidden behind a secret door in a bookcase, Le Chamber is one of Seoul’s leading speakeasy-style cocktail bars. Its experienced owner-bartenders serve precisely crafted classic and signature cocktails alongside an extensive selection of whiskies. The bar has also played an important role in developing Seoul’s cocktail culture while fostering a new generation of bartenders.

Drinks are chosen for their flavor and character, and paired with Korean dishes made with seasonal regional ingredients. Rather than relying on elaborate fusion, the menu focuses on quality ingredients and the fundamentals of Korean cooking, offering an accessible introduction to Korean food and drink in Gwanghwamun.

restaurants.description:
Soko is a cocktail bar led by bartender Son Seok-ho, with communication and balance at the heart of its approach. Its cocktails emphasize carefully measured flavors and attentive interaction with each guest, including creations recognized at international competitions. A cozy interior reminiscent of a late-19th-century Korean salon and warm service create Soko’s distinctive yet approachable bar experience.
Cover Charge ₩10,000

restaurants.name: Alice Cheongdam
restaurants.description:
Alice Cheongdam has established itself in Seoul’s bar scene with creative cocktails and a speakeasy concept inspired by Alice in Wonderland. Led by head bartender Park Yong-woo, the bar incorporates Korean ingredients and sensibilities while exploring new ideas through collaborations with chefs. Its imaginative setting and carefully crafted cocktails create a distinctive experience of Seoul’s contemporary cocktail culture.
Foggy Fongo ₩27,000
Bordeaux Martini ₩27,000

restaurants.name: Bar Jangsaeng
restaurants.description:
Bar Jangsaeng occupies a former health tonic shop that operated for 20 years, transforming its original identity into a contemporary cocktail bar. Working with local market vendors, the bartenders incorporate nearby produce as well as Korean traditional spirits and ingredients into their drinks. Details such as house-brewed oriental raisin tree tea preserve the history of the original shop while connecting cocktail culture with the surrounding neighborhood.
Classic Cocktail ₩17,000
Whisky by the Glass ₩16,000

restaurants.name: ZEST
restaurants.description:
Taking its name from “Zero Waste,” ZEST places sustainability at the heart of its cocktail program. It works with seasonal ingredients from local producers, makes its own spirits and carbonated mixers, and minimizes waste by using each ingredient as fully as possible. By combining distinctive flavors with creative reuse, ZEST presents a sustainable approach to Seoul’s contemporary bar culture.
Cocktail - Variable Price

Created by Lim Byungjin, the bartender behind BAR CHAM and Bar Pomme, Cham in Season focuses on Korea’s four seasons and fermentation. Its menu changes every three months to highlight seasonal ingredients, while house-made kombucha and other fermented elements add distinctive layers of flavor. In an intimate space in Seochon, each drink captures the ingredients and tastes of the season.
Seasonal Moscow Mule - Variable Price

Opened in Bangbae-dong in 2015, Maison M.O builds on classic French pastry while drawing inspiration from the everyday scenes and seasons of Seoul. Its desserts explore ingredients through carefully layered flavors, aromas and textures, alongside distinctive interpretations of French classics such as madeleines and mille-feuille. Creations such as “Paris Seoul,” inspired by the city’s street-side peanut trucks, transform familiar memories of Seoul into pastry.

Led by chef Seong Hyun-ah, SONA brings the intricacy of fine-dining plated desserts into a more casual setting. Seasonal fruits and carefully selected ingredients are composed with restrained sweetness and a precise balance of acidity and texture, creating desserts structured much like individual courses. With a longstanding focus on plated desserts, SONA has continued to develop its own distinctive approach to the genre.

Alongside fruits at their peak, he freely incorporates unexpected ingredients such as perilla leaves, burdock and doenjang, using sweetness to bring contrasting flavors into balance. Delicate expressions of individual ingredients and inventive combinations define JAEIN’s distinctive approach to pastry.

Its signature Madeleine Series ranges from familiar flavors to inventive ingredient combinations, with new creations introduced regularly.
Madeleine - Price varies

cafes.description:
Le Montblanc is a French pastry shop opened in HBC’s Sinheung Market by Jeon Sun-hye, who completed a pastry diploma at Le Cordon Bleu Tokyo. The café preserves the history of the family’s former knitwear factory by incorporating its yarn, machinery, and tools into the interior. It offers seasonal éclairs and mousse cakes, with yarn-shaped mousse cakes as its signature.

cafes.description:
Richemont was founded in 1979 by Kwon Sang-beom, a certified Korean master baker, and remains committed to quality ingredients and traditional baking techniques rather than passing trends. Its signature items include chestnut bread, first introduced in the 1980s, cream puffs that became popular in Hongdae in the 1990s, and chestnut pies. The wide-ranging selection also includes familiar Korean bakery favorites, German-style rye bread, and traditional French pastries.
Cream Puff ₩3,700-

cafes.name: Maison M.O
cafes.description:
Opened in Bangbae-dong in 2015, Maison M.O builds on classic French pastry while drawing inspiration from the everyday scenes and seasons of Seoul. Its desserts explore ingredients through carefully layered flavors, aromas and textures, alongside distinctive interpretations of French classics such as madeleines and mille-feuille. Creations such as “Paris Seoul,” inspired by the city’s street-side peanut trucks, transform familiar memories of Seoul into pastry.
Paris Seoul ₩9,600-
Classic Madeleine ₩3,500-

Mille Gâteaux is a French pastry shop opened by chef Ko Je-wook in Seocho-dong in 2010, with a name meaning “a thousand cakes.” Guided by the aim of introducing classic, traditional French desserts, the shop offers a range of cakes and baked confections. Its signature mille-feuille layers crisp pastry made with low-moisture dry butter and rich crème mousseline.
Mille-feuille ₩11,000-

cafes.description:
Bawiwi is the expanded and relocated space of Taffin, a French bakery originally established in Huam-dong. Continuing the legacy of a family who ran Boulangerie Pâtisserie Taffin in Lyon, France, in 2012 before opening Taffin in Seoul in 2019, it offers naturally fermented bread, pastries, desserts, and sandwiches. The relaxed space also features a rooftop overlooking Namsan and the Seoul skyline.

Located in Buam-dong, Boobing is a dessert shop specializing in bingsu, or Korean shaved ice. Its menu ranges from classic red bean bingsu made with domestically grown beans sourced through contract farming to seasonal varieties featuring strawberries, sweet corn, potatoes, and figs. Each bingsu is served as an individual portion, with selections changing throughout the year.

Bean Brothers Coffeehouse Seoul offers a range of ways to explore coffee selected and roasted by the brand. The sixth-floor coffee bar focuses on the flavors and aromas of each coffee, while the seventh floor provides a relaxed setting for coffee and conversation. The distinct spaces accommodate everything from a single cup to a comparative tasting of several coffees.

Piaf is a specialty chocolate shop run by chocolatier Ko Eun-soo and named after the French chanson singer Édith Piaf. Distinctive chocolates from selected cacao-growing regions are used to make bonbons, chocolate bars, and drinks. Its signatures include drinks made with grand cru chocolate and crisp potato flakes coated in French chocolate.

It roasts more than 20 varieties of green coffee in small batches and introduces a new hand-drip selection each month. Guests can explore teas from Korea, China, and Taiwan, while a selection of teaware is also displayed and available for purchase. Tea classes and workshops offer further opportunities to learn about tea and its traditions.

cafes.name: SONA
cafes.description:
Led by chef Seong Hyun-ah, SONA brings the intricacy of fine-dining plated desserts into a more casual setting. Seasonal fruits and carefully selected ingredients are composed with restrained sweetness and a precise balance of acidity and texture, creating desserts structured much like individual courses. With a longstanding focus on plated desserts, SONA has continued to develop its own distinctive approach to the genre.

Created to mark the tenth anniversary of Starbucks Reserve in Korea, this location occupies a renovated private residence in Jangchung-dong. Seven distinct areas, including a lounge and music room, retain original features such as stone walls, a fireplace, and a staircase, complemented by vintage furniture from the 1960s to the 1980s and works by Korean artists. An outdoor garden and terrace extend the experience beyond coffee to architecture, art, and music.

It selects coffees from around the world and oversees the process from roasting to brewing to express the flavors and origin of each bean. Amor Napoli is a Neapolitan-style bakery café specializing in breads and desserts from southern Italy. Based on traditional Italian recipes, its products use flour from Naples and natural sourdough, with adjustments made for Korean ingredients and climate. The selection centers on wood-fired breads alongside traditional Italian pastries such as aragosta and a range of gelato.

The building’s original framework and traces of age have been preserved alongside glass and contemporary elements, with both table and floor seating available. Chef Lee Jaein combines Korean ingredients with French pastry techniques to create a changing selection of seasonal desserts. Alongside fruits at their peak, he freely incorporates unexpected ingredients such as perilla leaves, burdock and doenjang, using sweetness to bring contrasting flavors into balance. Delicate expressions of individual ingredients and inventive combinations define JAEIN’s distinctive approach to pastry.

Tasting menus can be paired with cocktails and spirits, offering another way to explore the interplay between desserts and drinks.

cafes.name: Chachaithe
cafes.description:
Chachaithe is a tea and confectionery shop in Hannam-dong offering sweets designed to complement both Eastern and Western teas. Using seasonal ingredients, it creates a variety of tea confections inspired by dessert traditions from both cultures. The sweets are also available for purchase as gifts, while its intimate tea room offers a tea and confectionery experience by reservation. The second floor displays a collection of teaware sourced from Korea and abroad.
Tea Confections - Variable

cafes.description_zh:
Chachaithe 是漢南洞的茶和糖果店，提供與東西方茶相搭配的糖果。它使用當季食材，以兩種文化的甜點傳統為靈感，創造出各種茶甜點。這些糖果也可以作為禮物購買，而其溫馨的茶室則透過預訂提供茶和糖果體驗。二樓展示了來自韓國和國外的茶具收藏。
茶甜點 - 可變

cafes.name: Crémiel
cafes.description:
Crémiel is a French pâtisserie run by pastry chefs Mickaël Mégnien Boeha and Ji Su-jeong. Its pastries are made with French Label Rouge flour, AOP-certified butter, and antibiotic-free milk and eggs, while all doughs, jams, and creams are prepared in-house. The selection includes classic French pastries such as croissants, pains au chocolat, kouign-amann, and canelés.
Flan Parisien ₩7,000-
Chausson aux Pommes ₩6,500-

cafes.name: Taegeukdang
cafes.description:
Established in 1946, Taegeukdang is the oldest bakery in Seoul. Its name and rose of Sharon emblem reflect the founder’s aspirations for Korea at the beginning of the post-liberation era. The bakery continues to make breads and sweets such as red bean buns and castella using long-standing recipes, while its milk monaka remains a signature enjoyed across generations.
Milk Monaka ₩3,300-
Red Bean Bun ₩3,000-

cafes.description_zh:
太極堂成立於 1946 年，是首爾最古老的麵包店。其名稱和玫瑰沙龍徽章反映了創始人在解放後時代初期對韓國的渴望。這家麵包店繼續採用古老的配方製作麵包和甜食，例如紅豆包和卡斯特拉，而其牛奶最中仍然是代代相傳的招牌菜。
牛奶最中 ₩3,300-
紅豆包 ₩3,000-

cafes.name: Pâtisserie MÛR
cafes.description:
Led by chef Choi Kyusung, Pâtisserie MÛR builds on classic French pastry with Korean ingredients and contemporary sensibilities. Its refined creations focus on the character of each ingredient and the flavors developed over time, with baked goods such as brandy cake at the heart of the selection. The pâtisserie aims to make carefully crafted pastry a natural part of everyday life.
Brandy Cake ₩85,000-
Petit Cake ₩12,000

cafes.description_zh:
Pâtisserie MÛR 在主廚 Choi Kyusung 的帶領下，以經典法式糕點為基礎，融合韓國食材和現代感。其精緻的創作著重於每種成分的特性和隨著時間的推移而發展的口味，以白蘭地蛋糕等烘焙食品為核心選擇。這家糕點店旨在讓精心製作的糕點成為日常生活的一部分。
白蘭地蛋糕 ₩85,000-
小蛋糕 ₩12,000

cafes.name: Passion 5
cafes.description:
Passion 5 is SPC Group’s first flagship store and a long-standing dessert destination in Hannam-dong. Divided into bakery, pâtisserie, chocolate, and café sections, it offers a wide selection of cakes, tarts, baked sweets, and pastries. Its extensive range includes elaborate desserts, Baumkuchen, and assorted baked goods for gifts.
Blooming Red Rose ₩77,000-
Autumn Marron Pie ₩4,700-
cafes.google_maps_verification: Generated from official name + official address; open link to confirm the current Google Maps place.
cafes.description_zh:

盛開的紅玫瑰 ₩77,000-
秋季栗子派 ₩4,700-

cafes.name: Près de Moi Nonhyeon
cafes.description:
Près de Moi is a bakery run by chef Yoon Hwa-young, who has worked in French cuisine for more than 20 years. Baguettes, campagne, focaccia, and loaves are made with French flour and natural sourdough, then used for sandwiches prepared to order. The menu includes sandwiches with house-made terrine, corned beef, and jambon, as well as French dinner dishes.
Reuben Sandwich ₩21,000-
Jambon Cheese or Jambon-Beurre Sandwich ₩18,000-

Près de Moi 是一家麵包店，由主廚 Yoon Hwa-young 經營，他在法國美食領域工作了 20 多年。法國麵包、坎帕尼麵包、佛卡夏麵包和麵包均採用法國麵粉和天然酵母製成，然後用於製作按訂單準備的三明治。菜單包括三明治、自製陶罐、鹹牛肉和火腿，以及法式晚餐菜餚。
魯本三明治 ₩21,000-
Jambon 起司或 Jambon-Beurre 三明治 ₩18,000-

cafes.name: Fritz Coffee Company, Dohwa
cafes.description:
Founded by a team of coffee professionals, Fritz Coffee Company has focused on making high-quality coffee approachable and accessible. Its carefully sourced and roasted coffees are served alongside bread and pastries from its own bakery, while branding inspired by familiar Korean imagery gives Fritz a distinctive identity. Housed in a renovated old-style Korean residence, the Dohwa location brings its coffee and bakery culture together in one of the brand’s signature spaces.
Espresso ₩5,300-
Long Black ₩5,300-

cafes.description_zh:
Fritz Coffee Company 由咖啡專業團隊創建，致力於讓高品質咖啡變得平易近人。其精心採購和烘焙的咖啡與自家麵包店的麵包和糕點一起供應，而受熟悉的韓國形象啟發的品牌形象賦予 Fritz 獨特的身份。 Dohwa 店位於一棟經過翻修的老式韓國住宅內，將咖啡和麵包文化融合在品牌的標誌性空間之一。
濃縮咖啡 ₩5,300-
長款黑色₩5,300-

cafes.name: House of Shinsegae Dessert Salon
cafes.description:
House of Shinsegae Dessert Salon presents teas and traditional sweets developed by the Shinsegae Korean Food Research Institute through its study of Korea’s seasons, natural ingredients, and refreshment culture. Each menu uses seasonal Korean produce and traditional preparation methods interpreted in a contemporary format. Its composed setting offers a considered introduction to the flavors and presentation of Korean tea and sweets.
Signature Dessert Set ₩35,000-
Seasonal Dessert Set ₩35,000-

cafes.name: HAAP Wonseo
cafes.address_from_list: 2F, New Building, Arario Museum, 83, Yulgok-ro, Jongno-gu, Seoul
cafes.description:
Chef Shin Yong-il draws on his experience in both French pastry and Korean cuisine to reinterpret traditional Korean sweets in contemporary ways. His creations include juak made from glutinous rice dough fermented with makgeolli and yakgwa that is baked rather than fried. Through an ongoing exploration of traditional ingredients and techniques, HAAP offers a modern perspective on Korean rice cakes and confections.
Juak ₩3,000-

cafes.name: Hell Cafe Music
cafes.description:
Hell Cafe Music is the third location of Hell Cafe, which began in Bogwang-dong, and opened in Euljiro Record Tower in October 2023. Combining a café, record bar, and record shop, it plays a curated selection of music through Tannoy Westminster Royal speakers. Alongside the brand’s established coffee menu, this location offers exclusive items including lemonade, mousse cakes, and highballs.
Hell Latte ₩6,000-
Drip Coffee ₩7,000-

cafes.name: Horang Gasi
cafes.description:
Horang Gasi is a four-story bakery café housed in a renovated old residence in Gangnam. Retaining the building’s vintage character, it serves freshly baked breads, coffee, and ice cream. The menu includes seasonal items made with Korean ingredients, soft serve made with Sangha Farm milk, and coffee drinks topped with the ice cream.
Ice Cream Latte ₩8,000-
Bubble Foam Horang Einspänner ₩7,500-

blue_ribbon_3.description:
A restaurant serving classic Mediterranean cuisine. We make eco-friendly food that preserves the natural taste of the ingredients using seasonal ingredients grown directly on the farm. It is also good paired with wine with seafood dishes.

[Representative menu]
Wani Table (290,000), Wani Farm (260,000)
blue_ribbon_3.description_zh:
餐廳供應經典地中海美食。我們使用直接在農場種植的時令食材製作環保食品，並保留了食材的自然風味。它也適合搭配葡萄酒和海鮮菜餚。

[代表選單]
瓦尼餐桌 (290,000)、瓦尼農場 (260,000)
blue_ribbon_3.description_ko:
클래식한 지중해식 요리를 선보이는 레스토랑. 농장에서 직접 재배한 제철 식재료로 재료 본연의 맛을 살리는 친환경 음식을 만든다. 해산물 요리에 와인과 페어링하기도 좋다.

blue_ribbon_3.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 3 Ribbons (藍絲帶 3 條絲帶)
blue_ribbon_3.name: La Yeon
blue_ribbon_3.description:
A modern Korean restaurant with high satisfaction in taste, atmosphere, and service. We source the highest quality seasonal ingredients from across the country and present a modern interpretation of authentic Korean cuisine. The interior is modern yet simple, and the food served on pottery plates created by a ceramic artist is neat and tidy without being overly provocative. Alcohol pairing is also recommended, as each dish comes with a drink that goes well with it. The view from the 23rd floor is also great.

[Representative menu]
Silla Course (350,000), Layeon Course (220,000)
blue_ribbon_3.description_zh:
口味、氣氛、服務都非常滿意的現代韓國餐廳。我們從全國各地採購最優質的時令食材，以現代方式詮釋正宗的韓國美食。室內裝潢現代簡約，陶瓷藝術家製作的陶盤盛放的食物乾淨整潔，又不過於挑釁。也建議搭配酒精飲料，因為每道菜都配有與之相配的飲料。 23樓的風景也很棒。

[代表選單]
新羅路線 (350,000)、麗燕路線 (220,000)
blue_ribbon_3.description_ko:
맛과 분위기, 서비스 모두 만족도가 높은 모던 한식당. 전국에서 가장 질 좋은 제철 식재료를 수급하여 정통 한식 요리를 모던하게 해석해서 선보인다. 모던하면서도 심플한 인테리어에 도예가의 작품 그릇에 담아내는 음식도 자극적이지 않으면서 군더더기 없이 정갈하다. 각 요리에 어울리는 주류가 함께 나오는 주류 페어링도 추천. 23층의 전망도 훌륭하다.

[대표 메뉴]
신라코스(350,000), 라연코스(220,000)

blue_ribbon_3.name: Gaggen by Choi Jun-ho
blue_ribbon_3.description:
A kaiseki specialty restaurant run by chef Won Jin-hee, who gained extensive experience in kaiseki cuisine at Kurogi, and chef Choi Hyun-ah, who gained experience at Kanda, a famous restaurant in Tokyo. We cook with a variety of seasonal ingredients to bring out the full flavor. Signature menu items include Kurogi Somen handed down from Kurogi, Hasson, a seasonal dish served on one table, and Warabi Mochi made with bracken starch.

[Representative menu]
Omakase (400,000)
blue_ribbon_3.description_zh:
由在黑木積累了豐富懷石料理經驗的元珍熙主廚和在東京名店神田積累了豐富經驗的崔賢雅主廚經營的懷石料理專門店。我們以多種時令食材烹調，呈現完整的風味。招牌菜餚包括黑木傳世的黑木素麵、一桌時令菜餚哈森以及蕨菜澱粉製成的蕨麻糬。

[代表選單]
主廚發辦 (400,000)
blue_ribbon_3.description_ko:
가이세키요리로 잔뼈 굵은 쿠로기에서 경력을 쌓은 원진희 셰프와 도쿄 유명 식당인 칸다에서 경력을 쌓은 최현아 셰프가 선보이는 가이세키 전문점. 다양한 제철 식재료들을 활용해 풍미를 한껏 살려 요리한다. 시그니처 메뉴는 쿠로기에서 전수받은 쿠로기 소면, 계절 요리를 한 상에 담아낸 핫슨, 고사리 전분으로 만든 와라비 모찌 등이다.

[대표 메뉴]
오마카세(400,000)

A fine dining restaurant by chef Kang Min-cheol, who gained experience working in the restaurants of Parisian masters such as Joel Robuchon, Alain Ducasse, and Pierre Garnier. blue_ribbon_3.name: Kwonsooksoo
blue_ribbon_3.description:
Chef Woojung Kwon's Korean restaurant presents modern Korean style that interprets Korean food in a Western format. By using homemade soybean paste, kimchi, and vinegar, it is said to be modern yet retain the traditional taste of Korean food. It is also unique in that it embodies the traditional single person portrait. It constantly shows new features, such as introducing a kimchi cart made up of various types of kimchi.

[Representative menu]
Lunch Prize (240,000), Dinner Prize (380,000), Gourmet Prize (430,000)
blue_ribbon_3.description_zh:
主廚 Woojung Kwon 的韓國餐廳呈現現代韓國風格，以西方形式詮釋韓國美食。據說，使用自製的黃豆醬、泡菜和醋，既現代又保留了韓國食品的傳統味道。它的獨特之處還在於它體現了傳統的單人肖像。它不斷地展現出新的特色，例如推出了由各種泡菜組成的泡菜車。

[代表選單]
午餐獎（240,000）、晚餐獎（380,000）、美食獎（430,000）
blue_ribbon_3.description_ko:

Jambon Beur (10,800), Reuben (13,800), Charcuterie Sampler Board (22,000)
blue_ribbon_2.description_zh:
這是一家手工加工肉類工作坊，出售培根、火腿、香腸、煙燻牛肉、薩拉米香腸、火腿、肉醬等各種自製加工肉類，無論是包裝還是作為菜餚。他們提供冷三明治、熱三明治和熟食拼盤，並提供葡萄酒、雞尾酒和威士忌等飲料。

[代表選單]
Jambon Beur (10,800)、Reuben (13,800)、熟食樣品板 (22,000)

수제 가공육 공방으로, 베이컨, 햄, 소세지, 파스트라미, 살라미, 프로슈토, 파테 등 직접 만든 다양한 가공육을 팩으로 판매하거나 요리로 낸다. 콜드샌드위치와 핫샌드위치, 샤퀴테리플래터 등을 선보이며 이와 함께 즐길 수 있는 와인과 칵테일, 위스키 등의 음료가 있다.

잠봉뵈르(10,800), 루벤(13,800), 샤퀴테리샘플러보드(22,000)

blue_ribbon_2.description:
Anguk branch of Onion, a popular bakery cafe in Seongsu-dong. Unlike the trendy main branch, you can feel an old-fashioned atmosphere by remodeling a traditional hanok. The bread displayed in the bakery corner is a product of ‘Bread 05’, famous for its butter bread. Anchovy bread, anchovy bread, pandor, etc. are popular, and salt bread is also famous.

[Representative menu]
Ang Butter (5,500), Pandor (6,000), Signature Milk Tea (8,000)

Onion 的安國店，是聖水洞的熱門麵包店咖啡館。與時尚的總店不同，透過改造傳統的韓屋，您可以感受到老式的氛圍。麵包店展示的麵包是以黃油麵包聞名的“麵包05”的產品。鳀魚麵包、鯷魚麵包、潘多爾等很受歡迎，鹽麵包也很有名。

Ang Butter (5,500)、Pandor (6,000)、招牌奶茶 (8,000)

성수동의 인기 있는 베이커리 카페 어니언의 안국점. 트렌디한 본점과 달리 전통 한옥을 개조하여 고풍스러운 분위기를 느낄 수 있다. 베이커리 코너에 진열된 빵은 앙버터빵으로 유명한 ‘브레드05’의 제품. 앙버터빵, 앙스콘, 팡도르 등이 인기며, 소금빵도 유명하다.

앙버터(5,500), 팡도르(6,000), 시그니처밀크티(8,000)

blue_ribbon_2.description:
A patisserie shop run by a pastry chef couple, a French husband and a Korean wife. We present a variety of pastries made by French people. [Representative menu]
Croissant (5,500), Almond Croissant (7,500), Paeng Swiss (6,000)
blue_ribbon_2.description_zh:
一家糕點店，由一對糕點師夫婦、一位法國丈夫和一位韓國妻子經營。我們提供法國人製作的各種糕點。招牌羊角麵包是透過自己揉捏和烘烤薄片而製成的，由於使用不含抗生素的雞蛋以及法國麵粉和黃油等優質原料，因此價格昂貴。

프랑스인 남편과 한국인 아내의 파티시에 부부가 운영하는 파티세리 숍. 프랑스인이 직접 만든 페이스트리 종류를 선보인다. 시그니처인 크루아상은 시트를 직접 반죽하여 구우며, 무항생제 달걀, 프랑스산 밀가루와 버터 등 고급 원재료를 사용하기 때문에 가격대가 있는 편이다.

blue_ribbon_2.description:
A bakery specializing in European-style bread. It is no exaggeration to say that this is the place that started the European-style bakery boom in front of Hongdae. We mainly make unsweetened bread for meals rather than dessert bread. Popular menu items include black olive bread and ciabatta. 유럽식 빵을 전문으로 하는 베이커리. 홍대 앞의 유럽풍 베이커리 붐을 시작한 곳이라 해도 과언이 아니다. 디저트용 빵보다는 식사용의 달지 않은 빵을 주로 만들고 있다. 블랙올리브빵, 치아바타 등이 인기 메뉴. 큼지막하게 썰어 놓은 시식빵을 맛보고 빵을 고를 것을 추천한다.

blue_ribbon_2.description:
Bakery by chef Hwayoung Yoon, famous for French fine dining. We make our own bread for delicious sandwiches. Bambavka, Reuben sandwich, Campagne, etc. are featured.

프렌치 파인 다이닝으로 유명한 윤화영 셰프의 베이커리. 맛있는 샌드위치를 위해 직접 빵을 만든다. 밤바브카, 루벤샌드위치, 캄파뉴 등을 선보인다.

blue_ribbon_2.description:
Garosu-gil branch of Flower Artisan Baker in Munjeong-dong. Red bean paste and gourmet butter are added to whole wheat bread that is crispy on the outside and moist on the inside, giving it a savory yet sweet taste. Many flowers are displayed in a large space, making it a great place to take a break. This is the place that won the Le Bakery Baguette Championship in 2023 and 2024 consecutively.

[Representative menu]
Baguette (3,900), Creme Brulee Brioche (6,500), Ribbon Croissant (7,900)
blue_ribbon_2.description_zh:
文井洞Flower Artisan Baker的林蔭路分店。全麥麵包加入紅豆泥和極品牛油，外脆內嫩，味道香甜可口。寬敞的空間裡擺放著許多鮮花，是休息的好地方。這是2023年和2024年連續贏得Le Bakery Baguette冠軍的地方。

문정동에 있는 플라워아티장베이커의 가로수길점. 앙버터가 대표 메뉴로, 겉은 바삭하며 속은 촉촉한 통밀로 만든 빵에 팥앙금과 고메버터를 넣어 고소하면서도 달콤한 맛이 일품이다. 넓은 공간에 많은 꽃들이 전시되어 있어 쉬어가기 좋다. 2023년, 2024년 연속해서 르빵바게트챔피언십에서 우승을 한 곳이다.

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Ton shou
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. (Last order 8:00 p.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant serves Japanese-style tonkatsu (breaded pork cutlet). They make their tonkatsu to order, frying it first at a low temperature, then at a high temperature, and allowing it proper resting time before serving, resulting in meat that is tender, pink, and juicy. Eating it with Maldon salt, the royal salt of the UK, or adding mustard to the special sauce, reduces the greasiness.

[Signature Menu]
Berkshire K loseu gaseu (Berkshire K pork sirloin cutlet), loseu gaseu (pork sirloin cutlet), katsu sando (pork cutlet sandwich), modum gaseu (assorted cutlets), ebi gaseu (prawn cutlet)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳供應日式炸豬排（裹麵包屑的炸豬排）。他們按照客人的要求製作炸豬排，先用低溫煎炸，然後用高溫煎炸，並在上桌前留出適當的靜置時間，從而使肉質鮮嫩、粉紅色、多汁。與英國皇家鹽馬爾登鹽一起食用，或在特製醬汁中加入芥末，可以減少油膩感。

[招牌菜單]
Berkshire K Losu Gaseu（伯克希爾 K 豬裡肌肉排）、Losuu Gaseu（豬裡肌肉排）、Katsu Sando（豬排三明治）、modum Gaseu（什錦炸肉排）、Ebi Gaseu（蝦排）

visit_busan_100.award: Visit Busan 官方百大精選 (0 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Jyugajeonghyo
visit_busan_100.address: 3F, Haeundae La Muette, 620 Haeundae-ro, Haeundae-gu, Busan
visit_busan_100.hours: 6:00 p.m. - 11:00 p.m. (Last order 10:00 p.m.) - closed every Tuesday and Wednesday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
Led by Chef Myung Jung-hyo, a pioneering figure in Busan’s Japanese culinary scene, the kaiseki restaurant Juga Jung-hyo makes its long-awaited return. The restaurant presents a sake-focused, appetizer-driven course designed to maximize harmony with carefully selected sake, with the menu evolving approximately every month to reflect the flow of the seasons. A signature dish of chilled somen noodles generously infused with freshly ground sesame seeds stands as a defining highlight of the experience.

[Signature Menu]
kani (crab), beomgodong saenggang jorim (braised sea snail with ginger), sashimi (sliced raw fish), buri sio tataki (salted chopped yellowtail), hanu kushiage (deep-fried korean beef skewers), kamotsuke somyeon (cold buckwheat noodles dipped in warm duck broth), chamdom ochazuke (sea bream ochazuke), fugu zosui (pufferfish rice soup)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在釜山日本料理界的先驅主廚 Myung Jung-hyo 的帶領下，懷石料理餐廳 Juga Jung-hyo 期待已久的回歸。餐廳提供以清酒為主的開胃菜，旨在最大限度地與精心挑選的清酒和諧相處，菜單大約每月都會變化，以反映季節的變化。招牌菜是加入大量新鮮芝麻的冷素麵，是這次體驗的一大亮點。

[招牌菜單]
kani（螃蟹）、beomgodong saenggang jorim（薑汁燜海螺）、生魚片（生魚片）、buri sio tataki（鹽醃碎鰤魚）、hanu kushiage（炸韓式牛肉串）、kamotsuke somyeon（冷蕎河蘸熱）、米飯

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: HYTTE ROASTERY
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 8:00 p.m. | SAT, SUN 10:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m. - closed on holidays and Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This coffee shop is a rising star in the specialty coffee boom in Jeonpo-dong. They first opened in the Suyeong area but recently relocated to Jeonpo-dong. This light-roasting coffee shop, along with others like Mesh and Deep Blue Lake, has come to represent Korean coffee. They roast distinctive green coffee beans with clear fruity and floral aromas, and even coffees with a fascinating balance and sweetness are wellrepresented.

[Signature Menu]
espresso, Americano, caffe latte, flat white, vanilla latte, einspanner, filter coffee, apple and cinnamon ade, apple cinnamon black tea, cupcake (carrot / lemon / blueberry / black tea)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家咖啡店是田浦洞精品咖啡熱潮中的後起之秀。他們最初在水營地區開業，但最近搬到了田浦洞。這家輕度烘焙咖啡店與 Mesh 和 Deep Blue Lake 等其他咖啡店一起，已成為韓國咖啡的代表。他們烘焙出獨特的生咖啡豆，帶有清澈的果香和花香，甚至具有令人著迷的平衡和甜味的咖啡也得到了很好的體現。

[招牌菜單]
濃縮咖啡、美式咖啡、拿鐵咖啡、Flat White、香草拿鐵、Einspanner、滴濾咖啡、蘋果肉桂水、蘋果肉桂紅茶、紙杯蛋糕（胡蘿蔔/檸檬/藍莓/紅茶）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: BLACKUP COFFEE
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
Along with Momos, this specialty coffee company has come to represent Busan. They operate eight large coffee shops in Busan, Ulsan, and Gyeongnam. The most representative location is the first Blackup coffee shop in Seomyeon, which established Busan's Seomyeon Café Street. Their Blend Coffee Nero has been consistently popular for over ten years. Another favorite is their creative sea salt coffee, which combines cold brew coffee and fresh cream with a pinch of sea salt.

[Signature Menu]
hand-drip coffee, espresso, Americano, yuginong milk tea (organic milk tea), Victoria ttalgi cake (Victoria strawberry cake), malcha chocolat cake (matcha chocolat cake), basil cheese scone, vanilla madeleine, cherry financier
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家精品咖啡公司與Momos一起成為釜山的代表。他們在釜山、蔚山和慶尚南道經營八家大型咖啡店。最具代表性的地點是西面第一家Blackup咖啡店，它建立了釜山西面咖啡街。他們的 Blend Coffee Nero 十多年來一直很受歡迎。另一個最受歡迎的是他們的創意海鹽咖啡，它將冷泡咖啡和新鮮奶油與少許海鹽結合在一起。

[招牌菜單]
手沖咖啡、濃縮咖啡、美式咖啡、yuginong奶茶（有機奶茶）、Victoria ttalgi蛋糕（維多利亞草莓蛋糕）、malcha巧克力蛋糕（抹茶巧克力蛋糕）、羅勒起司烤餅、香草瑪德琳、櫻桃金融家

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Werk Roasters
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:00 a.m. - 6:30 p.m. (Last order 6:00 p.m.) - closed every Saturday and Sunday
visit_busan_100.description:
Along with Heate, this coffee shop is one of the leaders of the recent specialty-coffee wave in Busan. Coffee roasting, store management, planning, events, and creative activities are popular not only in Busan but also nationwide. The monastery-like store was so popular in the early days that numerous imitation stores appeared nationwide, but after the renovation, the atmosphere became more focused on the coffee itself.

[Signature Menu]
espresso, Americano filter coffee, caffe latte, cold brew, earl grey, bagel
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
與 Heate 一樣，這家咖啡店是釜山最近精品咖啡浪潮的領導者之一。咖啡烘焙、店舖管理、策劃、活動、創意活動不僅在釜山而且在全國都很受歡迎。這家修道院式的店早期非常受歡迎，以至於全國出現了無數的仿製品店，但改造後，氣氛變得更加專注於咖啡本身。

[招牌菜單]
濃縮咖啡、美式滴濾咖啡、拿鐵咖啡、冷萃咖啡、伯爵茶、貝果

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Momos
visit_busan_100.hours: 8:00 a.m. - 6:00 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This coffee shop opened in 2007 as a small takeout store near Oncheonjang Station. One of the founders, barista Jeon Joo-yeon, is the first Korean barista to win two consecutive World Barista Championships. The coffee shop, designed in the style of an old jeoksan gaok (Japanese colonial house), is beautiful, and they recently opened a large-scale roastery and second store in Yeongdo. The signature coffees are their Es Chocolat blend and Fruity Bonbon blend. The coffee shop was also the first in Korea to introduce many coffees from such sources as the Savage Coffee auction in Panama.

[Signature Menu]
hand-drip coffee of the day, Americano, espresso, kangkang (iced coffee with kumquat sherbet), cold brew, caffe latte, seasonal tea, lemon pound cake, croissant, cream brownie, cheese cake
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家咖啡店於 2007 年開業，是 Oncheonjang 站附近的小型外帶店。創辦人之一咖啡師Jeon Joo-yeon是第一位連續兩次獲得世界咖啡師錦標賽冠軍的韓國咖啡師。這家咖啡店的設計風格是古老的jeoksan gaok（日本殖民時期的房子），很漂亮，他們最近在影島開了一家大型烘焙店和第二家店。招牌咖啡是 Es Chocolat 混合咖啡和 Fruity Bonbon 混合咖啡。該咖啡店也是韓國第一家引進來自巴拿馬 Savage Coffee 拍賣會等來源的咖啡的咖啡店。

[招牌菜單]
每日手沖咖啡、美式咖啡、濃縮咖啡、康康（金橘果子露冰咖啡）、冷萃咖啡、拿鐵咖啡、時令茶、檸檬磅蛋糕、羊角麵包、奶油布朗尼、起司蛋糕

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Ops
visit_busan_100.hours: 8:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This bakery is one of the most popular in Busan and is known for its large, soft, and non-greasy choux cream puffs. Their choux cream puff bread is also gaining popularity and can sell out quickly, so you need to hurry

[Signature Menu]
Hagwonjeon (sponge cake), chamchi ppang (stuffed tuna bread), jayeonhyomo ppang (sourdough bread), myeongnan baguette (pollack roe baguette), honey cream cheese, danggeun cake (carrot cake), brioche roll, sogeum ppang (salted butter roll), mascarpone pudding
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家麵包店是釜山最受歡迎的麵包店之一，以其大而柔軟且不油膩的泡芙奶油泡芙而聞名。他們的泡芙奶油泡芙麵包也很受歡迎，很快就賣完了，所以你要抓緊時間

[招牌菜單]
Hagwonjeon（海綿蛋糕）、chamchi ppang（釀金槍魚麵包）、jayeonhyomo ppang（酸麵包）、明南法棍麵包（明太子法棍麵包）、蜂蜜奶油芝士、danggeun蛋糕（胡蘿蔔蛋糕）、奶油蛋捲、sogeum ppang（鹹黃油卷）、馬斯卡彭布丁

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Brilliant
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. (Closed when sold out) - closed every Monday and Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This bakery specializes in baked confectioneries and serves traditional French sweets. Pre-ordering is required one day in advance, as they operate primarily with pre-orders and sell out quickly.

[Signature Menu]
Brilliant collection, Brillant grand boîte, madeleine, financier, canelé, gâteaux au citron, galette bretonne, santtalgi hateusyu (raspberry chou)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家麵包店專門生產烘焙糖果，並供應傳統的法國糖果。需要提前一天預訂，因為他們主要以預訂為主，很快就賣完了。

[招牌菜單]
Brilliant 系列、Brillant grand boîte、瑪德琳、金融家、canelé、gâteaux au citron、galette bretonne、santtalgi hatusyu（覆盆子週）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: bread365
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 7:30 p.m. (Closed when out of ingredients) - closed every Sunday
visit_busan_100.description:
This bakery offers a variety of baked goods. Their various kinds of baguettes are popular. Their delicately layered croissants and plain bread are also delicious.

[Signature Menu]
croissant, ciabatta, basil meongmul baguette (basil & squid ink baguette), bam sikppang (chestnut loaf bread), tongmil sikppang (whole wheat bread), ttalgi pastry (strawberry pastry), jambon sandwich
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
这家面包店提供各种烘焙食品。他们的各种法棍面包很受欢迎。他們的分層精緻的牛角麵包和白麵包也很美味。

[招牌菜單]
羊角麵包、夏巴塔麵包、羅勒 meongmul 法國麵包（羅勒和墨魚汁法國麵包）、bam sikppang（栗子麵包）、tongmil sikppang（全麥麵包）、ttalgi 糕點（草莓糕點）、果醬三明治

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Bonheur Pâtisserie
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 7:00 p.m. - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.description:
This dessert café is known for its sweet bread, baked goods, and cakes. They also serve a variety of teas to accompany the desserts. Some of their most popular items include the Mont Blanc and forêt blanche

[Signature Menu]
Mont Blanc cake, bûchette, forêt blanche, fraisier, poire caramel (caramel pear cake), canelé, jeorinbae clafouti (clafouti aux poires), caffe allongé, caffe latte, tea
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家甜點咖啡館以其甜麵包、烘焙食品和蛋糕而聞名。他們還提供各種茶來搭配甜點。他們最受歡迎的產品包括 Mont Blanc 和 forêt blanche

[招牌菜單]
萬寶龍蛋糕、bûchette、forêt blanche、fraisier、poire caramel（焦糖梨蛋糕）、canelé、jeorinbae cafouti（clafouti aux poires）、阿隆咖啡、拿鐵咖啡、茶

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: MONSIEUR VINCENT
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 4:20 p.m. - closed every Monday and Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This French-style bakery cafe uses French ingredients, like flour, salt, butter, and chocolate. Their most popular bread is the stick-shaped baton, and a maximum of five can be purchased per person.

[Signature Menu]
baton, baguette, oat almond, pain au chocolat, croissant, cinnamon roll, olives
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家法國麵包咖啡館使用法國食材，如麵粉、鹽、奶油和巧克力。他們最受歡迎的麵包是棒狀麵包，每人最多可以購買五個。

[招牌菜單]
接力棒、法國麵包、燕麥杏仁、巧克力痛、羊角麵包、肉桂捲、橄欖

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: MUG Dessert LAB
visit_busan_100.hours: 1:00 p.m. - 7:00 p.m. (Last order 6:00 p.m.) - closed every Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This is a place where you can indulge in luxuriously plated desserts. The light purple lavender mousse topped with violets is a popular item, and the raspberry jam pairs perfectly with the tart pastry.

[Signature Menu]
Americano, caffe latte, sainthonoré, pistachio Paris-brest , lavender mousse tart with Marco Polo ganache and raspberry, raspberry saint-honoré, masion chocolat éclair
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在這裡，您可以盡情享用豪華的甜點。淺紫色薰衣草慕斯配上紫羅蘭是人氣單品，覆盆子果醬與撻皮完美搭配。

[招牌菜單]
美式咖啡，拿鐵咖啡，聖奧諾雷，開心果巴黎布列斯特，薰衣草慕斯餡餅配馬可波羅甘納許和覆盆子，覆盆子聖奧諾雷，巧克力閃電泡芙

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: lesmains patisserie
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 7:00 p.m.  - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.description:
This place specializes in traditional French pastries, such as madeleines and financiers. The chocolate tarts, which are rich in chocolate, and the millefeuilles are among the most popular menu items. They also have seasonal items, such as strawberry mille-feuilles and chestnut madeleines.

[Signature Menu]
ttalgi mille-feuille (strawberry mille-feuille), tarte chocolat, orange cocoa madeleine, muhwagwa keurimchijeu financier (fig butter cream cheese financier), Haenam bamgoguma crème brulée (sweet potato crème brulée), Americano, caffe latte
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這個地方專門提供傳統的法國糕點，例如瑪德琳蛋糕和金融家蛋糕。富含巧克力的巧克力餡餅和千層酥是最受歡迎的菜單項目。他們還提供季節性食品，例如草莓千層酥和栗子瑪德琳蛋糕。

[招牌菜單]
ttalgi mille-feuille（草莓千層酥）、塔特巧克力、橙子可可瑪德琳、muhwagwa keurimchijeu financier（無花果黃油奶油乳酪金融家）、Haenam bamgoguma crème brulée（紅薯焦糖布丁）、美式咖啡、拿鐵咖啡

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Haeundae somunnan amso  galbijip
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m - 3:10 p.m. / 4:30 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant is considered the birthplace of Haeundae-style ribs. Since opening in 1964, it has maintained its reputation for quality. After grilling the meat on the special grill pan shaped like a jeongol (hotpot) pan, you can order potato noodles to add and enjoy it like a hotpot. Because the restaurant is in a hanok (traditional Korean house), you feel like a guest in a nobleman's house. Many celebrities are frequent customers

[Signature Menu]
hanu saenggalbi (grilled Korean beef galbi), hanu yangnyeom galbi (grilled marinated Korean galbi), bulgogi, ttukbaegi doenjang (soybean paste jjigae hot pot)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳被認為是海雲台排骨的發源地。自 1964 年開業以來，一直保持著品質聲譽。在形狀像火鍋的特殊烤盤上烤完肉後，您可以點土豆麵條加入，像火鍋一樣享用。因為餐廳位於韓屋（韓國傳統房屋）內，所以您感覺就像是貴族家裡的客人。許多名人都是常客

[招牌菜單]
hanu saenggalbi（烤韓國牛肉 galbi）、hanu yangnyeom galbi（烤醃製韓國 galbi）、bulgogi、ttukbaegi doenjang（豆醬 jjigae 火鍋）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Halmae jaecheopguk
visit_busan_100.hours: 7:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This is the original restaurant in Samnakdong's "Jaecheop Alley." Along with an order of jaecheopguk (small clam soup), they serve rice, a large bowl for mixing, braised mackerel, kkakdugi (radish kimchi), kimchi, and doenjang-jjigae (soybean paste stew). The rice mixed with the jaecheop and seasoning goes perfectly with the refreshing soup. The reason their rice tastes so good is that they make their rice in a cast-iron pot.

[Signature Menu]
jaecheop guk (marsh clam soup), jaecheop hoe (raw marsh clams)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這是三樂洞「宰蹄胡同」的原創餐廳。除了蛤蜊湯之外，他們還提供米飯、一大碗拌菜、燉鯖魚、蘿蔔泡菜、泡菜和大醬湯。米飯與齋菜和調味料混合在一起，與清爽的湯完美搭配。他們的米飯之所以好吃，是因為他們用鑄鐵鍋做米飯。

[招牌菜單]
jaecheop guk（蛤蜊湯）、jaecheop hoe（生蛤蜊）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Pyeongsanok
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m. - closed every Sunday, on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in dwaeji-suyuk (boiled pork) and has a 100-year history. The suyuk is served in generous portions. The dwaeji-sagolguksu (pork bone noodle soup) they serve as a meal is a reliable option. Suyuk can also be purchased to take home.

[Signature Menu]
suyuk (boiled pork slices), guksu (noodles), yeolmu guksu (young summer radish kimchi noodles)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳專營dwaeji-suyuk（水煮豬肉），已有100年的歷史。 suyuk 的份量很足。作為餐點的 dwaeji-sagolguksu（豬骨麵條湯）是一個可靠的選擇。 Suyuk 也可以购买带回家。

[招牌菜單]
suyuk（水煮豬肉片）、guksu（麵條）、yeolmu guksu（年輕的夏季蘿蔔泡菜麵）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Chowonbokguk
visit_busan_100.hours: 9:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. (Last order 8:15 p.m.) - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant is renowned for its pufferfish cuisine and has been handed down for two generations over the past 60 years. You can choose from a variety of pufferfish dishes, such as bokchiri (clear pufferfish soup) and bok-maeuntang (spicy pufferfish soup), and you can choose the pufferfish you want. When you order a pufferfish full course set menu, you will be served pufferfish prepared a variety of ways: as shabu-shabu, deep-fried, in a sweet-and-sour salad, and as a porridge. It is so popular that there are branches all over Busan.

[Signature Menu]
bok guk (puffer fish soup), bok bulgogi (puffer fish bulgogi), bok course (pufferfish full-course set menu)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳以其河豚美食而聞名，已經在過去的60年裡傳承了兩代人。河豚料理有河豚清湯、河豚辣湯等多種河豚料理可供選擇，您可以選擇自己喜歡的河豚。當您訂購河豚全套套餐時，您將享用到以多種方式烹調的河豚：涮鍋、油炸、糖醋沙拉和粥。人氣很高，釜山各地都有分店。

[招牌菜單]
河豚湯、河豚烤肉、河豚套餐

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Wonjo halmaenakji
visit_busan_100.hours: 09:30 - 8:50 p.m. (Last order 8:10 p.m.) - closed every 2nd Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant has been serving nakji-bokkeum (stir-fried octopus) for over 50 years. This is nakjibokkeum, but their version contains broth, so it's more like jeongol (hot pot). The variation with beef small intestine is also recommended. The nakjibokkeum can be mixed with rice or boiled with udon noodles.

[Signature Menu]
nakji bokkeum (spicy stir-fried octopus), nakji saeu bokkeum (spicy stir-fried shrimp and octopus), nakji sogopchang bokkeum (spicy stir-fried beef intestines and octopus), nakji saeu sogopchang bokkeum (spicy stir-fried Shrimp, beef intestines, and octopus, sari (side order)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳供應 nakji-bokkeum（炒章魚）已有 50 多年的歷史。這是nakjibokkeum，但他們的版本包含肉湯，所以它更像jeongol（火鍋）。也推薦牛小腸的變種。 nakjibokkeum可以與米飯混合，也可以與烏龍麵一起煮。

[招牌菜單]
nakji bokkeum（辣炒章魚）、nakji saeu bokkeum（辣炒蝦和章魚）、nakji sogopchang bokkeum（辣炒牛腸和章魚）、nakji saeu sogopchang bokkeum（辣炒蝦、牛腸和章魚）、紗麗（配菜）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Yennal omakjip
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 9:30 p.m. (Last order 8:30 p.m.) - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in yang (smooth tripe) and gopchang (small intestine) and has over 60 years of tradition. Korean beef smooth tripe and small intestines are marinated in homemade sesame oil and marinade, and then grilled over charcoal. The smooth tripe, and small and large intestines are all of high quality, and the seasoning complements the flavors perfectly. The seasoning sauce is Gyeongsang-do style, made by mixing red pepper powder and starch syrup. The smooth-tripe fried rice is also delicious.

[Signature Menu]
teuk yang (ox tripe), daechang (grilled beef large intestines), gopchang (grilled beef small intestines / grilled pork small intestines), baekteugyang (grilled beef tripe special), yeomtong (grilled thinly-sliced beef heart), kongpat (beef kidneys)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳的特色菜是羊肚和小腸，已有 60 多年的傳統。韓國牛的光滑牛肚和小腸用自製的芝麻油和醃料醃製，然後在木炭上烤。光滑的牛肚、小腸和大腸都是優質的，調味料與味道相得益彰。調味醬是慶尚道風格的，由紅辣椒粉和澱粉糖漿混合而成。滑肚炒飯也很好吃。

[招牌菜單]
牛肚、大腸、牛腸、白頭羊、烤牛心、牛腎

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Sinheunggwan
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.description:
This 70-year-old restaurant specializes in Sichuan Chinese cuisine. Popular menu items include the jajang-myeon (noodles and Sichuan sauce with a fiery, smoky flavor) and classic tangsuyuk (sweet-and-sour beef or pork) with large chunks of cucumber, carrots, and jelly ear mushrooms. In addition, they serve delicious kkanpunggi (spicy garlic fried chicken).

[Signature Menu]
jjajangmyeon (noodles in black bean sauce), udon, jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup), tangsuyuk (deep-fried pork with sweet and sour sauce), kkanpunggi (sweet and spicychicken)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家有70年歷史的餐廳主打川菜。受歡迎的菜單包括炸醬麵（麵條和四川醬，帶有火辣的煙熏味）和經典的糖醋牛肉或豬肉，配上大塊黃瓜、胡蘿蔔和果凍耳蘑菇。此外，他們還提供美味的kkanpunggi（辣蒜炸雞）。

[招牌菜單]
jjajangmyeon（豆豉麵）、烏龍麵、jjamppong（辣海鮮湯麵）、tangsuyuk（糖醋炸豬肉）、kkanpunggi（甜辣雞）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Sinchan ggukbap
visit_busan_100.hours: 9:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This place serves dwaeji-gukbap (pork soup with rice), which has a refreshing and savory flavor. It also serves well-cooked suyuk (steamed pork) and sundae (Korean sausage) in generous portions. This place is located in Nampo-dong International Market and has become a popular tourist destination in Busan because of its delicious food.

[Signature Menu]
This place serves dwaeji-gukbap (pork soup with rice), which has a refreshing and savory flavor. It also serves well-cooked suyuk (steamed pork) and sundae (Korean sausage) in generous portions. This place is located in Nampo-dong International Market and has become a popular tourist destination in Busan because of its delicious food.
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這裡供應豬肉湯飯，味道清爽可口。它還提供大量煮熟的suyuk（蒸豬肉）和sundae（韓國香腸）。這個地方位於南浦洞國際市場，因其美味的食物而成為釜山的熱門旅遊目的地。

[招牌菜單]
這裡供應豬肉湯飯，味道清爽可口。它還提供大量煮熟的suyuk（蒸豬肉）和sundae（韓國香腸）。這個地方位於南浦洞國際市場，因其美味的食物而成為釜山的熱門旅遊目的地。

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Sinbarwon
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m. - closed every Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant is well-known for its Chinese dumplings, which have a thick yet soft skin and a well-balanced filling of ginger and pork. In addition to Chinese dumplings, they also specialize in Chinese breads such as pat-bbang (red-bean bread) and dalgyal-bbang (egg bread). Bean soup, which is a popular breakfast food in China, is served with snacks. This restaurant has a history of over 70 years.

[Signature Menu]
gogi mandu (meat mandu), jjin gyoja (steamed dumplings), gun mandu (pan-fried mandu), maepgun (spicy seasoned fried mandu), saeu gyoza (shrimp dumplings), mala mandu
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳以其中國餃子而聞名，餃子皮厚而柔軟，薑和豬肉的餡料均衡。除了中國餃子外，他們還專營中國麵包，如紅豆麵包和雞蛋麵包。豆湯是中國流行的早餐食品，搭配小吃。這家餐廳已有70多年的歷史。

[招牌菜單]
gogi mandu（肉mandu）、jjin gyoja（蒸餃）、gun mandu（煎mandu）、maepgun（辣炸mandu）、saeu gyoza（蝦餃）、mala mandu

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Songjeong samdae gukbap
visit_busan_100.hours: Open 24 hours a day - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant's dwaeji-gukbap (pork soup with rice) is made from the best cuts of pork and is milky and clean-tasting. Another popular item is their chapssal-sundae (Korean sausage), which is made with glutinous rice instead of cellophane noodles. They have been in business for 80 years and are one of the original restaurants in Seomyeon's "dwaeji-gukbap Alley.

[Signature Menu]
dwaeji gukbap (pork soup with rice), sundae gukbap (sundae and rice soup), naejang gukbap (offal and rice soup), ttaro gukbap (rice and soup), suyuk baekban (boiled pork slices set menu), chapssal sundae (sweet rice sundae), suyuk (boiled pork slices)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳的豬肉湯飯是用最好的豬肉製成的，奶味十足，味道乾淨。另一種受歡迎的食品是他們的chapssal-sundae（韓國香腸），它是用糯米而不是玻璃紙麵條製成的。他們已經營業了 80 年，是西面「豆汁湯飯胡同」最早的餐廳之一。

[招牌菜單]
豬肉湯飯、聖代湯飯、內臟湯飯、塔羅湯飯、水煮豬肉片套餐、chapssal聖代、水煮豬肉片

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Seoul kkakdugi
visit_busan_100.hours: 8:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant has been serving seolleongtang (ox-bone soup) for over eighty years. Seolleongtang is a popular dish in Seoul, but it has also won over the taste buds of Busan residents. The restaurant only serves two side dishes, kimchi and kkakdugi (radish kimchi), but the flavor is excellent.

[Signature Menu]
seolleongtang (ox bone soup), gomtang (beef bone soup), yangjitang (brisket and flank soup), suyuk (boiled pork slices)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳提供牛骨湯已有八十多年的歷史。宣陵湯是首爾的熱門菜餚，但也贏得了釜山居民的味蕾。餐廳只提供兩種配菜，泡菜和蘿蔔泡菜，但味道很棒。

[招牌菜單]
牛骨湯、牛骨湯、羊肉湯、水煮肉片

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Saejinju sikdang
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 9:30 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This 70-year-old restaurant serves Jinju-style yukhoe bibimbap, a dish made with fresh raw beef and various vegetables that are evenly mixed together. When you order the bibimbap, they also serve seonjitguk (hangover soup with oxblood) and mul kimchi (water kimchi), which are delicacies. Other menu items include grilled bulgogi, pajeon (green-onion pancakes), and gaori-muchim (seasoned raw stingray).

[Signature Menu]
yukhoe bibimbap (beef tartare bibimbap), dolsot bibimbap (hot stone pot bibimbap), hoe bibimbap (raw fish bibimbap), seoksoe bulgogi (grilled bulgogi), yukhoe (beef tartare), gaori muchim (spicy ray salad), pajeon (green onion pancake)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家擁有 70 年歷史的餐廳供應晉州風格的生拌飯，這是一種用新鮮生牛肉和各種蔬菜均勻混合在一起製成的菜餚。點拌飯的同時，也提供了解酒湯和水泡菜，都是美味佳餚。其他菜單包括烤烤肉、pajeon（蔥煎餅）和 gaori-muchim（調味生黃貂魚）。

[招牌菜單]
韃靼牛肉拌飯、石鍋拌飯、韃靼拌飯、烤肉、韃靼牛肉、辣味沙拉、蔥煎餅

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: B&C
visit_busan_100.hours: 9:00 a.m. - 10:30 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This old bakery in Busan has been in business for over 40 years. Their popular menu items include the salad bun with potato-salad filling and pie manju. In addition to traditional breads, they also offer Mont Blancs and egg tarts.

[Signature Menu]
Busanae ppang (bread with sweet potato and cream cheese filling), croissant, French pie, mini castella, sangtu gwaja (white bean paste cookies), choco muffin, cheese muffin, pain de gênes, Mont Blanc bread, soboru ppang (Korean streusel bun), ttalgi saengkeurim mini cake (strawberry mini cake with whipped cream)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家位於釜山的老麵包店已經營業了40多年。他們受歡迎的菜單包括馬鈴薯沙拉餡的沙拉麵包和餡餅饅頭。除了傳統麵包外，他們還提供萬寶龍和蛋塔。

[招牌菜單]
Busanae ppang（地瓜和奶油乳酪餡麵包）、羊角麵包、法國餡餅、迷你卡斯特拉、sangtu gwaja（白豆沙餅乾）、巧克力鬆餅、奶酪鬆餅、pain de gênes、勃朗峰麵包、soboru ppang（韓國糖粉奶油細末麵包）、ttalgi saengkeurim 迷你奶油蛋糕（迷你蛋糕）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Busan myeongmul hoetjip
visit_busan_100.hours: - closed every 1st & 3rd Monday, on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This 80-year-old hoe-baekban-jip (sashimi restaurant) is located in Jagalchi Market. The generous portions of thick-cut sashimi, the chojang (sour and spicy dipping sauce), and the side dishes are all tantalizing. Their hoebaekban (sashimi set meal) comes with a plate of sashimi, rice, clear fish soup, and five or six side dishes. Depending on the season, salted fish intestines, salted rockfish, and crab sauce are also served.

[Signature Menu]
hoe baekban (sliced raw fish set menu), hoe bibimbap (raw fish bibimbap), mulhoe (cold raw fish soup), jeonbok juk (abalone rice porridge), dom meori tang (sea bream head stew), saengseon yangnyeomgui (grilled marinated fish head)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家擁有80年歷史的生魚片店位於札嘎其市場。分量十足的厚切生魚片、酸辣醬和配菜都讓人垂涎欲滴。他們的生魚片套餐配有一盤生魚片、米飯、清魚湯和五六個小菜。依季節的不同，還會提供鹹魚腸、鹹石斑魚、蟹醬等。

[招牌菜單]
生魚片套餐、生魚拌飯、冷生魚湯、鮑魚粥、燉鯛魚頭、生仙烤魚頭

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Baekgudang
visit_busan_100.hours: 7:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. - closed every Sunday
visit_busan_100.description:
This bakery in Busan has been in operation for over 60 years. The most popular item is their croizen, a soft roll filled with corn salad. They also sell a variety of other simple but delicious oldfashioned kinds of bread that are popular with those who have fond memories of them.

[Signature Menu]
