Baekgu pie (109-layered pastry with custard-cream filling), croizen (soft roll filled with corn salad), ssuk ssal sikppang (mugwort rice loaf bread), bluebarry sikppang (blueberry loaf bread), pat donut (donut with red bean filling), Italian croquette, chapssal pat donut (sweet rice red bean donut), baguette pizza, yachae ppang (vegetable bun), sausage pastry
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
这家位于釜山的面包店已经营业了 60 多年。最受欢迎的商品是他们的 croizen，一种充满玉米沙拉的软卷。他们还出售各种其他简单但美味的老式面包，深受那些对它们有美好回忆的人的欢迎。

[招牌菜單]
白九派（109層奶油餡餅）、croizen（玉米沙拉軟卷）、ssuk ssal sikppang（艾草米麵包）、bluebarry sikppang（藍莓麵包）、pat donut（紅豆餡）、意大利炸肉餅、chapssal pat donut（甜米紅豆豆餅）、義大利麵包

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Bae Jong-gwan Dongnae  samgyetang
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. (Last order 8:00 p.m.)  - closed every Monday and Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in samgyetang (chickenginseng soup) and has only two items on the menu: goong-joong yakgyetang (royal chicken soup with medicinal herbs) and Dongnae samgyetang. The soup is made with a large chicken, and the broth is rich and flavorful. A glass of ginseng wine is served before the soup, which is topped with green onions. The restaurant is popular and often has a long line of customers.

[Signature Menu]
Dongnae samgyetang (ginseng chicken soup), gungjung yakgyetang (chicken soup with medicinal herbs)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳主打參雞湯，菜單上只有兩種菜色：宮中藥雞湯和東萊參雞湯。湯是用大雞熬煮的，湯汁濃鬱，味道鮮美。喝湯前先喝一杯人參酒，湯上撒上蔥。這家餐廳很受歡迎，經常排隊。

[招牌菜單]
東萊參雞湯、宮中藥雞湯

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: puffer fish soup
visit_busan_100.hours: Open 24 hours a day - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
Here, you can enjoy clean-tasting bokguk (pufferfish soup). The key to making bokguk is to use enough meat and prepare a flavorful broth, and this restaurant is known for its delicious bokguk with a rich, concentrated broth. The restaurant is small but popular, so you may have to wait in line during lunchtime.

[Signature Menu]
bok guk (puffer fish soup), bok maeuntang (spicy puffer fish stew), eunbok suyuk (boiled brown-backed toadfish slices), daegutang (codfish soup)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在這裡，您可以品嚐到味道純正的河豚湯。製作白飯的關鍵是使用足夠的肉和準備美味的湯，這家餐廳以其美味的白飯和濃鬱的湯而聞名。餐廳雖小，但很受歡迎，因此午餐時間可能需要排隊等候。

[招牌菜單]
bok guk（河豚魚湯）、bok maeuntang（辣河豚燉湯）、eunbok suyuk（煮褐背蟾蜍片）、daegutang（鱈魚湯）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Mulkkong sikdang
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant has been making agui-jjim (braised spicy monkfish) for over 60 years. They use only fresh monkfish, so their agui-jjim has a clean taste and a refreshing aftertaste. The scent and taste of their agui-jjim may be unfamiliar because it contains Korean mint leaves, which are eaten by people from Gyeongsang-do.

[Signature Menu]
agwi jjim (spicy braised monkfish), agwi suyuk (boiled monkfish slices), agwi tang (monkfish soup)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳製作 agui-jjim（紅燒安康魚）已有 60 多年的歷史。他們只使用新鮮的安康魚，所以他們的阿吉吉姆味道乾淨，回味清爽。他們的 agui-jjim 的氣味和味道可能會很陌生，因為它含有韓國薄荷葉，慶尚道人會吃這種薄荷葉。

[招牌菜單]
agwi jjim（辣燜安康魚）、agwi suyuk（煮安康魚片）、agwi tang（安康魚湯）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Dongnae halmaepajeon
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 3:30 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. - closed every Monday and Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant has been in business for over eighty years and has been passed down through four generations. It is famous for its pajeon, which is a thick green onion pancake that is hearty enough to be a meal on its own. The pajeon has a rich flavor and is made with a mixture of various seafood, including clams, shrimp, oysters, mussels, and other seafood and fried in rapeseed oil. The restaurant also offers a popular Korean table setting menu, which includes pajeon, braised godong-jjim (steamed seasoned turban shells), golbaengi-muchim (moon snail salad), and deodeok-gui (grilled lance asiabell root).

[Signature Menu]
Dongnae pajeon (Dongnae green onion pancake), Dongnae godong jjim (steamed sea snails), yakcho jeonbyeong muchim (medicinalherb buckwheat pancake and duck salad), samsaek deodeok gui (grilled deodeok root), golbaengi muchim (sea snail salad), Ttugisang (set menu), Ttumisang (set menu)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳已經營業了八十多年，已經傳承了四代。它以其蔥餅而聞名，這是一種厚厚的蔥煎餅，足以單獨作為一頓飯。蔥餅味道濃鬱，用蛤蜊、蝦子、牡蠣、貽貝等各種海鮮混合後，用菜籽油油炸而成。餐廳還提供受歡迎的韓國餐桌套餐，其中包括蔥餅、紅燒 godong-jjim（蒸調味頭巾）、golbaengi-muchim（月螺沙拉）和 deodeok-gui（烤矛根）。

[招牌菜單]
東萊蔥餅、東萊高東jjim、藥草煎餅、鴨肉沙拉、samsaek deodeok gui（烤deodeok根）、golbaengi muchim（海螺沙拉）、Ttugisang（套餐）、Ttumisang（套餐）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Gijang gomjangeo
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. (Last order 8:30 p.m.) - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant is the originator of grilling Gijang gomjangeo (sea eel from Gijang) over a straw fire. After the sea eel has been moderately grilled over a straw fire, you can peel off the charred skin to reveal the golden brown flesh, which you can cut in bite-size pieces and dip in sesame oil or salt. You can have pine needle sea eel, which imparts an aromatic flavor, and sea eel doenjangguk (bean paste soup), which has a savory flavor.

[Signature Menu]
gomjangeo (inshore hagfish (straw fire-grilled, grilled marinated, grilled whole, or salt-grilled)), gomjangeo maeuntang (spicy inshore hagfish stew), gomjangeo doenjangguk (inshore hagfish soybean paste soup)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳是用稻草火烤機張鰻魚的鼻祖。將海鰻用稻草火適度烤熟後，剝去燒焦的皮，露出金黃色的肉，切成一口大小，沾上香油或鹽即可。可以品嚐芳香四溢的松針海鰻和美味的海鰻豆醬湯。

[招牌菜單]
gomjangeo（近海盲鰻（稻草火烤、醃製烤、整條烤或鹽烤））、gomjangeo maeuntang（辣味近海盲鰻燉湯）、gomjangeo doenjangguk（近海盲鰻大醬湯）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Geumyong
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:30 - 8:30 p.m. - closed every Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This is a place where you can enjoy handmade, oldfashioned steamed dumplings. It is run by an ethnic Chinese. The dumplings are made fresh daily, so they are juicy and flavorful. Fried dumplings are also a popular menu item, and mandu gukbap (dumpling soup and rice) is recommended for a full meal. You can feel the passion that has gone into making dumplings for over 50 years. Please note that fried dumplings are only available after 10:30 AM.

[Signature Menu]
mul mandu (boiled mandu), jjin mandu (steamed mandu), gun mandu (pan-fried mandu), mandu gukbap (mandu rice soup)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在這裡您可以品嚐到手工製作的老式小籠包。它是由一位華人經營的。餃子是每天新鮮製作的，因此多汁可口。炸餃子也是很受歡迎的菜單項目，推薦吃餃子湯飯。你可以感受到50多年來包餃子的熱情。請注意，煎餃僅在上午 10:30 後供應。

[招牌菜單]
mul mandu（煮mandu）、jjin mandu（蒸mandu）、gun mandu（煎mandu）、mandu gukbap（mandu米湯）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Geumsubokguk
visit_busan_100.hours: Open 24 hours a day - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This is the oldest bokguk restaurant in the Haeundae area. Bokguk (pufferfish soup) is Busan's representative hangover soup, and a bowl of clear jiri bokguk completely cures a hangover. The spicy bokmaeuntang is also popular, but if you want to enjoy cleantasting pufferfish, the jiri bokguk is recommended. On the second floor, they offer a variety of pufferfish course set menus.

[Signature Menu]
bok guk (puffer fish soup), bok twigim (deep-fried puffer fish), bokkkeopjil twigim (fried puffer fish skin) , bok kkeopjil muchim (puffer fish skin salad), bok jjim (braised puffer fish), bok suyuk (boiled puffer fish slices), bok sashimi (sliced raw puffer fish)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這是海雲台地區最古老的福氣店。河豚湯是釜山的代表性解酒湯，一碗清澈的河豚湯完全可以解酒。辣味炒飯湯也很受歡迎，但如果您想品嚐乾淨美味的河豚，推薦吉里炒飯。二樓提供各種河豚套餐。

[招牌菜單]
bok guk（河豚湯）、bok twigim（炸河豚）、bokkkeopjil twigim（炸河豚皮）、bok kkeopjil muchim（河豚皮沙拉）、bok jjim（紅燒河豚）、bok suyuk（水煮河豚片）、bok 豚片（生河豚片）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Gupochonguksu
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:30 - 3:00 p.m.ㅣSAT, SUN 10:30 - 7:00 p.m. - closed every Monday, on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in just one thing: myeolchi guksu (noodles in anchovy broth). When you order noodles, you will be served boiled noodles and a kettle of broth, and you can pour as much broth as you like over the noodles. The broth is prepared by simmering anchovies from the southern coast of Korea. It is best enjoyed with plenty of chopped Cheongyang peppers. This restaurant is considered to be the originator of Gupo noodles.

[Signature Menu]
guksu (noodles)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳只擅長一件事：myeolchi guksu（鯷魚湯麵）。點麵的時候，會端上煮好的麵條和一壺湯，你可以在麵條上澆多少湯。湯是用韓國南部海岸的鳳尾魚慢火熬煮而成的。最好搭配大量切碎的青陽辣椒一起享用。這家餐廳被認為是姑婆面的鼻祖。

[招牌菜單]
麵條

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Gaegeum milmyeon
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 7:40 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant has been serving milmyeon (wheat noodles) for over fifty years, making it one of the oldest milmyeon restaurants, along with Gaya Milmyeon. The noodles are made with a combination of wheat flour and sweet potato starch, which gives them their characteristic chewy texture. In the summer, expect to wait in line for a table.

[Signature Menu]
mul milmyeon (cold wheat noodles) , bibim milmyeon (spicy wheat noodles), Gaegeum mandu , gogigomyeong (meat garnish), hoegomyeong chuga (extra sliced raw fish garnish)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳提供米麵（小麥麵條）已有五十多年的歷史，與伽耶米麵一樣，是最古老的米麵餐廳之一。麵條由小麥粉和紅薯澱粉混合製成，具有特有的耐嚼質地。在夏天，需要排隊等候餐桌。

[招牌菜單]
mul milmyeon（冷小麥麵）、bibim milmyeon（辣小麥麵）、Gaegeum mandu、gogigomyeong（肉裝飾）、hoegomyyeong chuga（額外切片生魚裝飾）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Yuksimnyeon jeontong  halmaegukbap
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m. - closed every Sunday, on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant is famous for its Busan-style dwaeji-gukbap (pork soup with rice) with Chinese chives. The soup is clear and refreshing, and the taste is enhanced by adding plenty of Chinese chives. 'Subaek' means suyuk-baekban, which is rice and pork soup with the boiled pork slices and sundae (Korean sausage) served on the side

[Signature Menu]
dwaeji gukbap (pork soup with rice), naejang gukbap (offal and rice soup), guksu (noodles), ttaro gukbap (rice and soup), suybaek (boiled pork slices set menu), suyuk (boiled pork slices)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳以其釜山風格的韭菜豬肉湯飯而聞名。湯汁清澈爽口，加入大量韭菜，味道更加鮮美。 「Subaek」的意思是suyuk-baekban，這是一種米飯和豬肉湯，旁邊配有煮熟的豬肉片和聖代（韓國香腸）

[招牌菜單]
Dwaeji gukbap（豬肉湯飯）、naejang gukbap（內臟和米湯）、guksu（麵條）、ttaro gukbap（米飯和湯）、suybaek（水煮豬肉片套餐）、suyuk（水煮豬肉片）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: HAREMA
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 2:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. | TUE, WED 5:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.description:
Here, they serve sushi omakase (chef's choice) made with fresh, high-quality seasonal ingredients. In the dinner course set menu, more than ten kinds of tsumami (Japanese hors d'oeuvres) are offered first. Served on a Dior plate, their signature dish is tuna, sea urchin, and avocado mousse, which is wrapped in laver before eating. They serve Mazuma wasabi that they bring in by air from Shizuoka and grate just before serving.

[Signature Menu]
lunch set, dinner, first seating , dinner, second seating
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在这里，他们提供采用新鲜优质时令食材制成的寿司 omakase（厨师精选）。晚餐套餐中，首先提供的是十余种日本开胃小菜。他们的招牌菜是装在迪奥盘子上的金枪鱼、海胆和牛油果慕斯，吃前用紫菜包裹起来。他们提供从静冈空运而来的 Mazuma 芥末，并在上菜前磨碎。

[招牌菜單]
午餐套餐, 晚餐, 第一座位, 晚餐, 第二座位

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: palate
visit_busan_100.hours: 6:00 p.m. - 11:00 p.m. | FRI, SAT, SUN 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 6:00 p.m. - 11:00 p.m. - closed every Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This French restaurant claims to be a neobistro. From amuse-bouches to appetizers and main courses, the dishes are beautifully plated and made with high-quality ingredients. The restaurant started as a wine bar, so wine pairing is highly recommended.

[Signature Menu]
lunch full-course set menu, dinner course
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家法國餐廳自稱是新小酒館。從開胃菜到開胃菜和主菜，菜餚擺盤精美，並採用優質食材製成。該餐廳最初是一家酒吧，因此強烈建議搭配葡萄酒。

[招牌菜單]
午餐全套餐、晚餐套餐

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: PALAIS DE CHINE
visit_busan_100.description:
This modern Chinese restaurant in the Grand Josun Busan hotel has a panoramic ocean view. Their Peking duck is definitely the standout dish, while chili shrimp with Shaoxing wine and smoked grouper are also popular choices. You can also enjoy signature dishes from Hongyeon in the Westin Josun, such as buldojang ('Buddha-JumpsOver-the-Wall' soup) and tangsuyuk (sweet and sour pork). The Peking duck must be ordered at least two days in advance.

[Signature Menu]
lunch full-course set menu, dinner course, bukgyeong ori (Peking duck), Ibérico chashu, basakhan samgyeopsal barbecue (crispy barbecued pork belly), jeonbog yangjangpi (abalone starch sheet salad with mustard sauce), buldojang (Buddha's temptation soup), sacheonsik laziji (Sichuan spicy chicken with eggplant), hunyeonhyang mero (smoked patagonian toothfish)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這間現代化的中餐廳位於 Grand Josun 釜山酒店內，享有大海全景。他們的北京烤鴨絕對是最出色的菜餚，而紹興酒辣椒蝦和熏石斑魚也是受歡迎的選擇。您也可以在威斯汀朝舜酒店享用 Hongyeon 的招牌菜餚，如 buldojang（“佛跳牆”湯）和 tangsuyuk（咕嚕肉）。北京烤鴨必須至少提前兩天預訂。

[招牌菜單]
午餐全套餐、晚餐套餐、北京烤鴨、伊比利亞叉燒、烤五花肉、鮑魚澱粉片沙拉配芥末醬、佛陀醬、四川茄子辣子雞、薰香mero（燻巴塔哥尼亞齒魚）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: CHAORAN
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 6:00 p.m. - 9:30 p.m. (Last order 9:00 p.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This is a Chinese restaurant located in the Signiel Hotel in Busan. They offer modern Cantonese cuisine in a setting inspired by 1920s Hong Kong. During the day, you can enjoy dim sum and tea, while the evening hours are perfect for cocktails at the bar

[Signature Menu]
lunch set , dinner set, Chaoran's Peking duck, dim sum selection
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這是一家位於釜山西格尼爾飯店的中餐廳。他們在受 20 年代香港啟發的環境中提供現代粵菜。白天，您可以享用點心和茶，而晚上則非常適合在酒吧享用雞尾酒

[招牌菜單]
午餐套餐、晚餐套餐、超然北京烤鴨、精選點心

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Yulling
visit_busan_100.food_subtype_en: course menu with grilled Korean beef
visit_busan_100.hours: 5:20 p.m. - 9:30 p.m. | SAT, SUN 5:00 p.m. - 9:30 p.m. - closed every Wednesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This Korean beef restaurant offers a luxurious dining experience with a stunning ocean view of Haeundae. Enjoy omakase (chef's choice) Korean beef dishes combining Japanese and French style. The restaurant has counter seats, several private rooms, and a large wine cellar.

[Signature Menu]
course menu, special full-course set menu, hanu gui (grilled Korean beef), glass wine pairing
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家韓國牛肉餐廳提供豪華的用餐體驗，並可欣賞海雲台的壯麗海景。享受融合日式和法式風格的 omakase（廚師精選）韓國牛肉菜餚。餐廳設有吧台座位、數個私人空間以及一個大型酒窖。

[招牌菜單]
套裝菜單、特別全套套餐、hanu gui（烤韓牛）、玻璃酒搭配

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: AOMORI
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 2:30 p.m. / 6:00 p.m. - 9:50 p.m. | SAT, SUN 11:30 a.m. - 2:50 p.m. / 6:00 p.m. - 9:50 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This Japanese restaurant located in the Centum Hotel offers high-quality sashimi. If you order a set menu, the sashimi is followed by a variety of seafood, vegetables and scallops, grilled beef, and then rice, soup, and side dishes. The sushi set menu is also popular, and the sake list is excellent too.

[Signature Menu]
lunch omakase, dinner sushi course
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家位於 Centum Hotel 的日本餐廳提供高品質的生魚片。如果點套餐，生魚片之後是各種海鮮、蔬菜和扇貝、烤牛肉，然後是米飯、湯和配菜。壽司套餐也很受歡迎，清酒單也很棒。

[招牌菜單]
午餐主廚搭配，晚餐壽司套餐

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Â POINT
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. - closed every Tuesday and Wednesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant offers course set menus, which you can enjoy while taking in the view of the open sea. The course set menu consists of eight dishes, all of which is French cuisine with a Korean twist. The highlight of the meal is the steak, which is followed by a combination of Korean side dishes. The fish dishes included in the set menu change seasonally. Reservations are required.

[Signature Menu]
lunch full-course set menu, dinner course
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳提供套餐，您可以一邊欣賞大海的美景一邊享用。套餐菜單由八道菜組成，全部都是帶有韓國風味的法國菜餚。這頓飯的亮點是牛排，其次是韓國配菜組合。套餐中的魚類菜餚隨季節變化。必須預定。

[招牌菜單]
午餐全套餐、晚餐套餐

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Sheobul
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This long-standing Korean restaurant in the Westin Chosun Busan Hotel serves traditional Korean cuisine with sincerity. Its banquet hall, which has a view of Haeundae, is a popular place for important events.

[Signature Menu]
course menu, hanu bulgalbi (grilled marinated Korean beef), hanu yukhoe bibimbap (Korean beef tartare bibimbap), hanu tteokgalbi bansangcharim (grilled Korean galbi patties set menu)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家位於釜山威斯汀朝鮮酒店的歷史悠久的韓國餐廳，真誠地供應傳統的韓國美食。其宴會廳可欣賞海雲台的景色，是舉辦重要活動的熱門場所。

[招牌菜單]
套餐菜單、hanu bulgalbi（烤醃製韓國牛肉）、hanu yukhoe bibimbap（韓國韃靼牛肉拌飯）、hanu tteokgalbi bansangcharim（烤韓國排骨肉餅套餐）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: SAKAE
visit_busan_100.description:
Located in Paradise Hotel, this Japanese restaurant serves authentic, high-quality cuisine made with fresh ingredients. The sushi counter is a popular choice, as is the teppanyaki, which highlights the natural flavors of the ingredients.

[Signature Menu]
course menu, set, cheolpan course (griddled dish course)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家日本餐廳位於Paradise Hotel 內，供應採用新鮮食材烹製的正宗高品質美食。壽司櫃檯是受歡迎的選擇，鐵板燒也是如此，突出了食材的天然風味。

[招牌菜單]
套餐菜單、套餐、鐵板套餐（乾鍋套餐）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Mugunghwa
visit_busan_100.description:
Located on the forty-third floor of Lotte Hotel Busan, this elegant Korean restaurant offers a panoramic view of Baekyang Mountain. They serve traditional cuisine for the nobility that has been reinterpreted as Korean set menus with a modern touch, making it popular with both Koreans and foreigners. The restaurant also has a wine list that pairs well with Korean food, as well as halal dishes for Muslims

[Signature Menu]
course menu, hanu bulgogi bansang (bulgogi set menu)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這間優雅的韓國餐廳位於釜山樂天飯店的四十三樓，享有白羊山的全景。他們為貴族提供傳統美食，現已將其重新詮釋為具有現代風味的韓國套餐，使其深受韓國人和外國人的歡迎。餐廳也提供適合韓國料理的酒單，以及適合穆斯林的清真菜餚

[招牌菜單]
課程菜單，hanu bulgogi bansang（烤肉包）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Mori
visit_busan_100.hours: 6:00 p.m. - 12:00 a.m. - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant offers a Japanese kaiseki dining experience with a view of Haeundae Beach. The authentic interior and staff's yukata (cotton kimono) create an immersive Japanese atmosphere. You can enjoy a wide range of dishes, from sashimi prepared with fresh seasonal ingredients, to suimono (broth), tempura, grilled dishes, and rice cooked in an iron pot. It is located on the second floor of Palé de Cz.

[Signature Menu]
course menu
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳提供日本懷石料理用餐體驗，並可欣賞海雲台海灘的景色。正宗的內部裝潢和員工的浴衣（棉質和服）營造出身臨其境的日本氛圍。可以品嚐到使用新鮮時令食材烹調的生魚片、水物、天婦羅、燒烤、鐵鍋米飯等豐富的菜餚。它位於 Palé de Cz 的二樓。

[招牌菜單]
課程選單

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Michael's Urban Farm Table
visit_busan_100.description:
This American restaurant serves American-style dishes made with seasonal ingredients from Busan. Fajitas, truffle spaghetti, and Michael's signature burger are all recommended menu items. We highly recommend the outdoor terrace seats, which offer stunning night views of Busan. It is located in F1963, a multicultural complex.

[Signature Menu]
full-course business set menu, Michael's course, salad, pasta, sandwich & burger, coconut shrimp, grilled calamari
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家美式餐廳供應以釜山時令食材烹調的美式菜餚。墨西哥捲餅、松露義大利麵和麥可的招牌漢堡都是推薦菜單項目。我們強烈推薦戶外露臺座位，可以欣賞到釜山的迷人夜景。它位於F1963，一個多元文化綜合體。

[招牌菜單]
全套商務套餐、邁克爾套餐、沙拉、義大利麵、三明治和漢堡、椰子蝦、烤魷魚

visit_busan_100.award: Visit Busan 官方百大精選 (0 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Le DORER
visit_busan_100.hours: 5:00 p.m. - 9:30 p.m. - closed every Wednesday
visit_busan_100.description:
You can enjoy set menus and stunning night views in this modern Korean cuisine bar with a luxurious atmosphere. It serves set menus including a wide variety of seasonal seafood, such as octopus, eel, and yellowtail.

[Signature Menu]
dinner course
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
您可以在這家氛圍豪華的現代韓國料理酒吧享用套餐並欣賞迷人的夜景。餐廳供應套餐，包括章魚、鰻魚和鰤魚等各種時令海鮮。

[招牌菜單]
晚餐課程

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: LABXXIV by KUmuda
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:30 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. (By reservation only) - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.description:
LAB XXIV Kumuda is a high-end French restaurant run by Chef Edward Kwon. Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of Songjeong Beach and refined full-course set menus at reasonable prices in a luxurious atmosphere. It is located on the fourth floor of the Kumuda Multiple Cultural Experience Space.

[Signature Menu]
lunch full-course set menu, dinner course
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
LAB XXIV Kumuda 是一家由主廚 Edward Kwon 經營的高級法國餐廳。在奢華的氛圍中享受令人驚嘆的松亭海灘全景，並以合理的價格享用精緻的全套套餐。位於庫姆達多元文化體驗空間四樓。

[招牌菜單]
午餐全套餐、晚餐套餐

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Nampung
visit_busan_100.description:
Nampoong Chinese Restaurant has been a wellknown high-end Chinese restaurant in Busan for many years. It reinterprets traditional Cantonese Chinese cuisine in a Korean style. Their signature dishes include fried Korean sea cucumber, Cantonese veal ribs, and buldojang ('BuddhaJumps-Over-the-Wall' soup), all made with their own recipes. The restaurant is located on the third floor of the new building of Paradise Hotel, and offers stunning views of the ocean.

[Signature Menu]
jeomsim course (full-course lunch set menu) , chef's signature course , special full-course set menu , buldojang (Buddha's temptation soup), eojahaesamsongi (fried Korean sea cucumber and pine mushroom)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
南豐中餐廳多年來一直是釜山知名的高級中餐廳。它以韓國風格重新詮釋傳統粵菜。他們的招牌菜包括韓國炸海參、粵式小牛肉排骨和buldojang（“佛跳牆”湯），全部採用他們自己的食譜製作。餐廳位於天堂飯店新樓三樓，可欣賞壯麗的海景。

[招牌菜單]
jeomsim套餐（全套午餐套餐）、廚師招牌套餐、特別全套套餐、佛陀湯、eojahaesamsongi（韓國炸海參松茸）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Chilseong hoetjip
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant is a great place to enjoy sekkosi (chopped raw small fish) while taking in the view of Gwangan Bridge. The secret of this restaurant's great-tasting food is the ssamjang (spicy soybean paste) that is served with the sekkosi. You can get high-quality sekkosi at a reasonable price, and the maeuntang (spicy seafood stew) made in an earthenware pot is also excellent.

[Signature Menu]
dodari sekkosi (bone-in sliced raw ridged-eye flounder), ureok (rockfish), gwangeo (flatfish), jabeo (small fish), sea bream, gwangeo tongmari (whole flatfish)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳是一邊欣賞廣安大橋景色一邊享用生小魚的好地方。這家餐廳的美味秘訣在於搭配sekkosi的ssamjang（辣醬）。您可以以合理的價格買到高品質的sekkosi，用陶鍋製作的maeuntang（辣味海鮮燉菜）也很棒。

[招牌菜單]
dodari sekkosi（帶骨切片生脊眼比目魚）、ureok（石斑魚）、gwangeo（比目魚）、jabeo（小魚）、海鯛、gwangeo tongmari（整條比目魚）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Ireok
visit_busan_100.hours: Open 24 hours a day - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in gomtang, a light and refreshing soup made with Korean beef. Their yang-gomtang (beef soup with smooth tripe) is also a popular menu item. The terrace offers stunning views of Gwangan Bridge.

[Signature Menu]
gomtang (beef bone soup), yanggomtang (beef tripe soup), teuk seokkeo gomtang (beef bone soup with beef tripe), suyuk (boiled pork slices)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳的特色是“gomtang”，這是一種用韓國牛肉製成的清淡爽口的湯。他們的yang-gomtang（帶有光滑牛肚的牛肉湯）也是受歡迎的菜單項目。露台享有廣安大橋的壯麗景色。

[招牌菜單]
gomtang（牛骨湯）、yanggomtang（牛肚湯）、teuk seokkeo gomtang（牛骨牛肚湯）、suyuk（水煮豬肉片）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Oryukdogawon
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 9:30 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in Korean beef and offers great views of the sea. The Korean beef is high-quality and is grilled over charcoal, giving it a delicious flavor. If you order grilled Korean beef during lunchtime, rice and naengmyeon (cold noodles in chilled broth or spicy sauce) are included. The restaurant's exterior, which artfully blends water features and lawns, is so beautiful that it won an architectural award. There is also a café next door, which is a great place to enjoy a cup of tea after your meal.

[Signature Menu]
galbitsal (grilled boneless galbi), deungsim (grilled sirloin), jebichuri (beef neck chain), kkotsal (grilled boneless short ribs)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳主打韓國牛肉，享有美麗的海景。韓國牛肉品質上乘，採用炭火烤製，味道鮮美。如果您在午餐時間點烤韓國牛肉，則包括米飯和冷麵（冷麵或辣醬）。餐廳的外觀巧妙地融合了水景和草坪，非常美麗，因此獲得了建築獎。隔壁還有一家咖啡廳，是飯後喝杯茶的好去處。

[招牌菜單]
galbitsal（烤無骨galbi）、deungsim（烤牛腰肉）、jebichuri（牛頸鏈）、kkotsal（烤無骨小排）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Mokjangwon
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 9:30 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
At this restaurant specializing in charcoal-grilled beef ribs, you can enjoy Korean and imported beef. Take in the stunning views of Taejongdae as you dine. You can also enjoy a cup of tea at Café de Bom on the second floor, or make use of the banquet hall or outdoor wedding hall.

[Signature Menu]
hanu deungsim (grilled Korean beef sirloin), hanu yangnyeom gui (grilled marinated Korean beef), hanu kkotdeungsim (Korean beef ribeye steak), yangnyeom galbitsal (grilled marinated boneless galbi), kkotgalbisal sogeumgui (grilled boneless galbi), hanu teuksubuwi modum (assorted special cuts of Korean beef), hanu kkotgalbisal (boneless Korean galbi), hanu gomtang (Korean beef bone soup), galbitang (galbi soup)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在這家炭烤牛肋排專賣店，您可以品嚐到韓國牛肉和進口牛肉。用餐時可欣賞太宗台的壯麗景色。您也可以在二樓的 Café de Bom 喝杯茶，或使用宴會廳或戶外婚禮廳。

[招牌菜單]
hanu deungsim（烤韓國牛沙朗）、hanu yangnyeom gui（烤醃製韓國牛肉）、hanu kkotdeungsim（韓國牛肋眼牛排）、yangnyeom galbitsal（烤醃製無骨排骨）、kkotgalbisal sogeumgui（烤無骨排骨）、hanu teuksubuwi 碎肉） kkotgalbisal（無骨韓國豬肋排）、hanu gomtang（韓國牛骨湯）、galbitang（豬肋排湯）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: McQUEEN'S Lounge
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This lounge is located in the Ananti Hilton Busan. It is a place to enjoy dessert and tea while taking in the fantastic ocean view. The signature menu items are their baked goods, which include cakes, and the afternoon tea set with a selection of signature teas.

[Signature Menu]
afternoon tea set, black tea, herbal tea, gwasil cha (fruit tea), nokcha (green tea), jeontongcha (traditional Korean tea), espresso, Americano, cappuccino, caffe latte, caffe mocha, vanilla latte
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
休息室位於釜山阿納蒂希爾頓酒店。這是一個一邊享用甜點和茶一邊欣賞美妙海景的地方。招牌菜單是他們的烘焙食品，其中包括蛋糕，以及包含精選招牌茶的下午茶套餐。

[招牌菜單]
下午茶套餐、紅茶、花草茶、水果茶、綠茶、韓國茶、濃縮咖啡、美式咖啡、卡布奇諾、拿鐵、摩卡咖啡、香草拿鐵

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: NEWLY
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. (Last order 9:00 p.m.) - closed every Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This steakhouse offers a stunning view of Gwangalli Sea and offers an à-la-carte menu. At lunch, a set menu is available that includes salad, pasta, Korean beef steak, and dessert. In the evening, it transforms into a wine bar.

[Signature Menu]
vongole pasta (clam pasta), formaggi pasta, chaekkeut steak (striploin steaks), ansim steak (tenderloin steak), gamja twigim (french fries), lunch set, dinner set
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家牛排館享有廣安里海的壯麗景色，並提供單點菜單。午餐時提供套餐，包括沙拉、義大利麵、韓式牛排和甜點。到了晚上，它就變成了一家酒吧。

[招牌菜單]
vongole pasta (clam pasta), formaggi pasta, chaekkeut steak (striploin steaks), ansim steak (tenderloin steak), gamja twigim (french fries), lunch set, dinner set

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Geumnang hoetjip
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 11:00 p.m. (Last order 10:00 p.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
At this restaurant located in Gwangalli Waterside Park, you can enjoy a Korean table setting while taking in the views of Gwangan Bridge. They serve fresh sashimi, as well as plentiful side dishes including maeuntang (spicy fish stew), steamed abalone, mero (toothfish) steak, assorted seafood, and shrimp sauce. This restaurant was visited by former President Moon Jae-in.

[Signature Menu]
Geumnang hansang (raw fish full-course), Subyeon hansang, Gwangan hansang (raw fish full-course), Bada hansang, teuk modum hoe (assorted sliced raw fish special), modum hoe (assorted sliced raw fish)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳位於廣安里水邊公園，您可以一邊享受韓式餐桌，一邊欣賞廣安大橋的景色。他們提供新鮮的生魚片以及豐富的配菜，包括maeuntang（辣燉魚）、蒸鮑魚、mero（齒魚）牛排、什錦海鮮和蝦醬。前總統文在寅曾光臨過這家餐廳。

[招牌菜單]
金囊韓生、水邊韓生、廣安韓生、巴達韓生、特製生魚片、現代生魚片

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Gyuujeong
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 11:00 p.m. (Last order 10:00 p.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in grilled beef and offers a stunning view of the ocean. When you order meat, you will be served basic side dishes and three seasonings: salt, sesame oil, and demi-glace. The aged meat is flavorful, and the omurice with demiglace is also a satisfying meal on its own.

[Signature Menu]
chaekkeut (striploin), ansim (grilled tenderloin), deungsim (grilled sirloin), kkotdeungsim (ribeye), teuk ansim (beef tenderloin), assorted grilled Korean beef cuts (rib-eye, tenderloin, brisket), omurice (rice-filled omelet)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳主打烤牛肉，並享有壯麗的海景。當你點肉的時候，你會得到基本的配菜和三種調味料：鹽、芝麻油和半糖霜。熟成的肉味道鮮美，配上半糖霜的蛋包飯本身也是一頓令人滿意的飯菜。

[招牌菜單]
chaekkeut（牛裡肌肉）、ansim（烤裡肌肉）、deungsim（烤牛裡肌）、kkotdeungsim（肋眼肉）、teuk ansim（牛裡肌肉）、什錦烤韓國牛肉塊（肋眼肉、裡肌肉、牛胸肉）、蛋包飯（米飯煎蛋捲）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Goseurak
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. (Last order 9:00 p.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This bungalow restaurant on the beach offers a stunning view and quality beef. A special feature is that it is dog-friendly. After your meal, it's nice to take a stroll along the beach.

[Signature Menu]
hanu deungsim gui (grilled Korean beef sirloin), hanu ansim (Korean beef tenderloin), hanu tteokgalbi sotbap jeongsik (grilled Korean galbi patties with hot stone pot rice)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家位於海灘上的平房餐廳提供壯麗的景色和優質的牛肉。一個特別的特點是它對狗友好。吃完飯後，沿著海灘散步也是不錯的選擇。

[招牌菜單]
hanu deungsim gui（烤韓國牛裡肌）、hanu ansim（韓國牛裡肌）、hanu tteokgalbi sotbap jeongsik（烤韓國排骨肉餅配熱石鍋飯）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Geobukseon hoetjip
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 11:00 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This sashimi restaurant is located in Mipo, Haeundae. It is well known for its excellent wildcaught sashimi, as well as its various side dishes and maeuntang (spicy fish stew). The secret to the delicious taste is their chojang, a sauce made by mixing various seasonings with red pepper paste that has been aged for six months. This restaurant is a favorite of former President Moon Jae-in.

[Signature Menu]
jayeonsan modum hoe (assorted sliced raw wild fish)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家生魚片餐廳位於海雲台尾浦。它以其優質的野生生魚片以及各種配菜和maeuntang（辣味燉魚）而聞名。美味的秘訣在於他們的chojang，這是一種將各種調味料與經過六個月陳釀的紅辣椒醬混合製成的醬汁。這家餐廳是前總統文在寅最喜歡的餐廳。

[招牌菜單]
jayeonsan modum hoe（什錦切片生野生魚）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Cappadocia
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 9:30 p.m. (Last order 8:30 p.m.) - closed every Tuesday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in Turkish cuisine, which is rare in Busan. You can taste various authentic Turkish dishes, including kebabs. Various types of kebabs are popular, and the grilled pirzola (lamb ribs marinated in traditional spices) is also recommended. The restaurant is owned and operated by a Turkish immigrant, and traditional Turkish handicrafts are displayed throughout the store.

[Signature Menu]
kebab, pirzola (lamb chops), pita, lunch set, Cappadocia special (set menu including ekmek, lavash, and kebabs)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳主打土耳其菜，這在釜山很少見。您可以品嚐各種正宗的土耳其菜餚，包括烤肉串。各種烤肉串都很受歡迎，烤皮爾佐拉（用傳統香料醃製的羊排）也很推薦。餐廳由一位土耳其移民擁有和經營，店內各處展示傳統的土耳其手工藝品。

[招牌菜單]
烤肉串、pirzola（羊排）、皮塔餅、午餐套餐、卡帕多西亞特色菜（套餐包括ekmek、lavash和烤肉串）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: ALOI THAI RESTAURANT
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. (Last order 8:20 p.m.) - closed every Tuesday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This is a premium "Thai Select" restaurant, certified by the Thai government. You can savor authentic Thai cuisine prepared by a chef from a hotel in Thailand. Especially popular dishes are the poo pad pong curry, made with crab and fresh cream, and the fried rice with plenty of fresh pineapple.

[Signature Menu]
poo pad pong curry (stir-fried crab and curry powder), poo nim pad pong curry (crispy fried soft-shell crab with curry powder), Thai sik haemul ssalguksu (Thai seafood rice noodles), pineapple bokkeumbap (pineapple fried rice), yum woon sen (Thai seafood and rice noodle salad), Aroi appetizer set menu
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這是一家經過泰國政府認證的高級「泰式精選」餐廳。您可以品嚐由泰國飯店廚師烹調的正宗泰國美食。特別受歡迎的菜餚是用螃蟹和鮮奶油製成的便便咖哩，以及加入大量新鮮鳳梨的炒飯。

[招牌菜單]
poo pad pong curry（炒蟹和咖哩粉）、poo nim pad pong curry（咖哩粉脆炸軟殼蟹）、Thai sik haemul ssalguksu（泰式海鮮米粉）、鳳梨 bokkeumbap（鳳梨炒飯套餐）、yum woon sen（泰式海鮮玉米粉（菠蘿）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: DAL THAI
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 4:30 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. (Last order 8:00 p.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This Thai restaurant's poo pad pong curry and tom yum goong are renowned. Here, you can enjoy authentic Thai cuisine. The food is even better when paired with Thai beer. The interior has been renovated and became modern and stylish.

[Signature Menu]
poo pad pong curry (stir-fried crab and curry powder), tom yum goong (hot and sour prawn soup),pad thai (Thai stir-fried rice noodles with meat and vegetables), green curry, red curry, som tam thai (Thai spicy green papaya salad), khao pad nea (beef fried rice), khao pad kung (shrimp fried rice), pat gra-prao moo sap (stir-fried minced pork), kao ka moo (braised pork trotters), quay tiew tom yum (tom yum noodle soup)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家泰國餐廳的便便咖哩和冬蔭功很有名。在這裡，您可以品嚐到正宗的泰國美食。配上泰國啤酒更美味。內部經過翻新，變得現代而時尚。

[招牌菜單]
poo pad pong curry（炒蟹和咖哩粉）、tom yum goong（酸辣蝦湯）、pad thai（泰式炒肉和蔬菜米粉）、綠咖哩、紅咖哩、som tam thai（泰式辣青木瓜沙拉）、khao 木瓜 nea（牛肉炒飯）、khao apoung prakao 炒肉、肉moo（紅燒豬蹄）、quay tiew tom yum（冬蔭功麵湯）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: RAEOAK
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:30 - 9:00 p.m. (Last order 8:00 p.m.) - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
The staff at this restaurant learned at Lai Ngọc, a rice noodle restaurant in Hanoi, Vietnam. They offer beef noodle soup with a clean-tasting broth. The bánh xèo is filled generously and also recommended. The interior, which recreates the atmosphere of the original restaurant, is also impressive.

[Signature Menu]
sogogi ssalguksu (beef rice noodles), Raeok pho ga (Raeok chicken pho), haemul bokkeumbap (seafood fried rice), banh xeo (crispy Vietnamese crêpes), goi cuon (cool shrimp, pork, or beef rice wraps), banh quay (fried breadstick), bunmangbit (Vietnamese duck vermicelli noodle soup), bun bo hue (spicy neef & pork noodle soup)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳的工作人員在越南河內的一家米粉店Lai Ngọc學習。他們提供牛肉麵湯，湯汁味道乾淨。 bánh xèo 分量很足，也推薦。再現了原來餐廳氛圍的內部也令人印象深刻。

[招牌菜單]
sogogi ssalguksu（牛肉米粉）、Raeok pho ga（Raeok 雞肉薄餅）、haemul bokkeumbap（海鮮炒飯）、banh xeo（脆皮越南薄餅）、goi cuon（涼蝦、豬肉或牛肉飯捲）、banh quay（炸麵包條）、buanga（

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Restaurant L’étang
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 6:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. (By reservation only) - closed every Monday and Tuesday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant offers French set menus that combine the chef's experience in France and Japan. The set menu changes seasonally according to what ingredients are locally available. The restaurant has a counter-style layout and is operated by a single chef, so reservations are essential. You can enjoy classic French dishes like escargot and rabbit at reasonable prices. There is also a diverse wine selection, so this is a good place for a glass of wine.

[Signature Menu]
season course
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳提供法式套餐，融合了主廚在法國和日本的經驗。套餐菜單根據當地食材隨季節變化。餐廳採用櫃檯式佈局，由一名廚師經營，因此必須提前預訂。您可以以合理的價格享用蝸牛、兔肉等經典法式菜餚。這裡的葡萄酒選擇也很豐富，所以這裡是喝杯葡萄酒的好去處。

[招牌菜單]
季節課程

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Lee Jae-mo Pizza
visit_busan_100.hours: - closed every Sunday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This pizza place is a local favorite, known for its delicious cheese. Their pepperoni pizza is popular. You can upgrade your pizza to a larger size for an additional 4000 won. Be prepared to wait, as it can get busy.

[Signature Menu]
crust pizza, ham cheese crust pizza, crust saeu pizza (shrimp pizza), pepperoni pizza, pasta
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家披薩店是當地人的最愛，以其美味的起司而聞名。他們的義大利辣香腸披薩很受歡迎。您可以額外支付 4000 韓元將披薩升級為更大尺寸。準備好等待，因為它可能會很忙。

[招牌菜單]
皮披薩、火腿起司皮披薩、皮薩烏披薩（蝦披薩）、義大利辣香腸披薩、義大利麵

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Osteria Aboo
visit_busan_100.address: 3F, The Sailing Tower, 23 Haeundae-ro 570beon-gil, Haeundae-gu, Busan, Republic of Korea
visit_busan_100.hours: 5:00 p.m. - 12:00 a.m. | SAT, SUN 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 12:00 a.m. - closed every Tuesday, on holidays (irregular)
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This is a great place to enjoy Italian cuisine and wine. The ddak-saewoo pasta, which harmonizes red-banded lobster from Jeju and linguine noodles, and the classic carbonara are popular dishes, and the osso buco risotto with tender veal is also highly recommended.

[Signature Menu]
oyster, tongbal dansaeu (wild-caught sweet shrimp), Jeju san chamokdom (Jeju red tilefish), muneo risotto (octopus risotto), osso buco risotto, carbonara pasta, Itallia gajae pasta (Italian lobster pasta), bollonyasik sogogi pasta (bolognese pasta), hanu two plus chaekkeut steak (hanu strip loin steak)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這是一個享用義大利美食和葡萄酒的好地方。將濟州島紅龍蝦與扁麵條融為一體的“ddak-saewoo”意大利麵和經典的意麵培根蛋麵都是受歡迎的菜餚，此外，還強烈推薦搭配嫩小牛肉的osso buco risotto。

[招牌菜單]
牡蠣、tongbal dansaeu（野生捕獲的甜蝦）、Jeju san chamokdom（濟州紅方頭魚）、muneo risotto（章魚燴飯）、osso buco risotto、carbonara 義大利麵、Itallia gajae 義大利麵（義大利龍蝦義大利麵）、bollonyask牛排（哈努帶裡肌牛排）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Chef Lee
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:30 p.m. - 12:00 a.m. - closed every Sunday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This Italian restaurant sticks to the basics, and the pasta dishes are the most popular items on the menu. The pizza is baked in an Italian woodfired oven, and you can taste the freshness of the ingredients. You can also enjoy Italian beer, which is not easily found elsewhere.

[Signature Menu]
aglio e olio pasta, cacio e pepe pasta, anchovy pasta, gorgonzola cheese pizza, prosciutto pizza, rucola pizza (arugula pizza), gambas al ajillo, maeun honghap jjim (spicy braised mussels), hanu chaekkeut (Korean beef strip loin)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家義大利餐廳堅持基本原則，義大利麵是菜單上最受歡迎的菜色。披薩以義大利燃木烤箱烘烤，可以品嚐到食材的新鮮度。您還可以品嚐到其他地方很難找到的意大利啤酒。

[招牌菜單]
aglio e olio 義大利麵、cacio e pepe 義大利麵、鯷魚義大利麵、戈貢佐拉起司披薩、火腿披薩、芝麻菜披薩（芝麻菜披薩）、gambas al ajillo、maeun honghap jjim（辣燜貽貝）、hanu chaekkeut（韓國牛腰肉）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Rione
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 6:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. (Last order 8:30 p.m.) - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This casual Italian restaurant is known for its delicious gnocchi. The potato-shaped gnocchi are perfectly paired with a rich truffle-and-cream sauce. The small garden in front of the entrance is a lovely touch.

[Signature Menu]
salad, seonggeal eoran pasta (sea urchin & cured fish roe pasta), chorizo aglio e olio pasta, tomato ragu oven panne pasta, algamja gnocchi (baby potatoes gnocchi)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家休閒義大利餐廳以其美味的麵疙瘩而聞名。馬鈴薯形狀的麵疙瘩與濃鬱的松露奶油醬完美搭配。入口前的小花園很可愛。

[招牌菜單]
沙拉、seonggeal eoran 義大利麵（海膽和醃魚子義大利麵）、chorizo aglio e olio 義大利麵、番茄肉醬烤箱 panne 義大利麵、algamja gnocchi（小馬鈴薯義大利麵）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: La ConTi
visit_busan_100.hours: 12:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:30 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. (Last order 8:30 p.m.) - closed every Tuesday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
At this restaurant, you can enjoy high-quality Italian cuisine. It is known for its fresh pasta, which is made daily in-house. The wood-fired oven pizza and steak are also highly recommended. The set menu, which consists of a variety of dishes, is also very satisfying.

[Signature Menu]
dinner course, saengmyeon pasta (fresh pasta), chaekkeut deungsim steak (striploin steaks)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在這家餐廳，您可以享用高品質的義大利美食。它以其每日自製的新鮮麵食而聞名。燃木烤爐披薩和牛排也非常推薦。套餐的菜色種類豐富，也非常滿意。

[招牌菜單]
晚餐套餐、生麵義大利麵（新鮮義大利麵）、chaekkeut deungsim 牛排（西冷牛排）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: TETE O NE
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description: This is a wine bar with a casual and lively atmosphere. Beef tartare, French-style minced raw beef, is a popular menu item and is served with baguette. Pasta is also available on the lunch menu. Liquor or soft drinks must be ordered with food.
visit_busan_100.description_zh: 這是一家氛圍輕鬆活潑的酒吧。韃靼牛肉，法國生牛肉末，是一種很受歡迎的菜單項，與法國麵包一起食用。午餐菜單上還提供麵食。酒類或軟性飲料必須與食物一起點。

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Zero Base
visit_busan_100.hours: 6:00 p.m. - 8:00 p.m. / 8:30 p.m. - 10:30 p.m. - closed every Sunday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
Here, they serve Japanese omakase (chef's choice) as a single course. Savor the genuine taste of the finest ingredients, such as fresh wasabi and sea urchin from Hokkaido. Various sake and tokuri (traditional sake flask) are also available to complement the dishes.

[Signature Menu]
course menu
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在這裡，他們提供日本 omakase（廚師選擇）作為一道菜。品嚐來自北海道的新鮮芥末和海膽等最優質食材的正宗味道。也提供各種清酒和 tokuri（傳統清酒瓶）來搭配菜餚。

[招牌菜單]
課程選單

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: YAKITORI Haegong
visit_busan_100.hours: 5:30 p.m. - 12:00 a.m. - closed every Sunday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This yakitori restaurant with a lavish decor is renowned for its yakitori omakase (chef's choice chicken skewers) made with domestically-raised chickens. You can try almost every part of the chicken, including the tenderloin, neck, oyster, Achilles tendon, thigh, wing, leg, and skin.

[Signature Menu]
yakitori omakase (chef's choice chicken skewers), chicken skewers, tsukune (japanese chicken meatball skewer), saengyachae boridoenjang (barley doenjang with fresh vegetables), chaeso gui (grilled vegetables), dak bong croquettes (chicken drumsticks croquettes), saeusisomari chungwon twigim (shrimp spring rolls with perilla leaves), cheese gui (grilled cheese)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
这家装修豪华的烤鸡肉串餐厅以其使用国产鸡制成的烤鸡肉串（厨师精选的鸡肉串）而闻名。您几乎可以尝试鸡肉的每个部位，包括里脊肉、颈部、牡蛎、跟腱、大腿、翅膀、腿和皮肤。

[招牌菜單]
yakitori omakase（厨师精选鸡肉串）、鸡肉串、tsukune（日本鸡肉丸串）、saengyachae boridoenjang（新鲜蔬菜大麦大酱）、chaeso gui（烤蔬菜）、dak bong 炸丸子（鸡腿炸丸子）、saeusisomari chungwon twigim （紫苏叶虾春卷）、芝士桂（烤芝士）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: SUSHI IRUKA
visit_busan_100.hours: Lunch: 12 a.m to 2 p.m. / Dinner: First seating from 5:30 p.m., Second seating from 8:00 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This sushi omakase (chef's choice) restaurant offers great value for the price. The shari (vinegared rice) made with akazu red vinegar pairs perfectly with rich-tasting fish like aji (horse mackerel) and saba (blue mackerel).

[Signature Menu]
lunch, dinner
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家壽司 omakase（廚師精選）餐廳物超所值。用阿卡祖紅醋製成的醋飯與竹莢魚和鯖魚等味道濃鬱的魚完美搭配。

[招牌菜單]
午餐、晚餐

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Sushi sian
visit_busan_100.hours: First seating 6:00 p.m. - 8:00 p.m. / Second seating 8:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. - closed every Sunday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This sushi restaurant offers sushi omakase (chef's choice) and is run by a solo chef. Dinner omakase is served in two sittings, only in the evening. Some people find the taste of the shari (vinegared rice) to be a bit strong, but others prefer it. Overall, the restaurant offers good value for the price.

[Signature Menu]
sushi omakase (chef's choice sushi)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家壽司餐廳提供壽司 omakase（廚師精選），由獨奏廚師經營。晚餐 omakase 分兩次供應，僅限晚上。有些人覺得Shari（醋飯）的味道有點濃，但其他人更喜歡它。總的來說，這家餐廳的性價比很高。

[招牌菜單]
壽司 omakase（主廚精選壽司）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: SHOJIN
visit_busan_100.hours: 6:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
Here, you can enjoy Japanese kaiseki (multicourse set menu). They use seasonal, high-quality ingredients, including geumtae (blackthroat seaperch), tuna, sea urchin roe, sweet shrimp, and beef. The meal is served in small portions, allowing you to try a variety of dishes, including sashimi, suimono (broth), soba (buckwheat noodles), grilled dishes, and rice cooked in an iron pot.

[Signature Menu]
omakase (chef's choice)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在這裡，您可以享用日本懷石料理（多道菜套餐）。他們使用時令優質食材，包括鮪魚、鮪魚、海膽子、甜蝦和牛肉。餐點是小份量的，可以品嚐生魚片、水物、蕎麥麵、燒烤、鐵鍋飯等多種菜餚。

[招牌菜單]
omakase（廚師選擇）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: MOZU
visit_busan_100.hours: 6:00 p.m. - 01:00 (Last order 12:00 a.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This is a great place to have a drink along with the set menu of otsumami (Izakaya-style side dishes). You can also order à la carte and choose from a wide variety of skewers and Japanese snacks. This branch in Busan was opened by Chef Yokomori, who is also the owner of Mozu, a popular restaurant in Sinsa-dong, Seoul.

[Signature Menu]
otsumami (finger foods) set menu, potato salad, dashimaki tamago (rolled omelet), tataki kyuuri (smashed cucumber salad), oshinko moriawase (assorted Japanese pickled vegetables), daikon sarada (radish salad), negi toro maki (sushi diced tuna with green onion), sunagimo (gizzard), nankotsu (chicken cartilage), seseri (grilled chicken neck), tebasaki (deep-fried chicken wings), momo (dumplings), udon, soba (Japanese buckwheat noodles)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在這裡，您可以一邊品嚐 otsumami（居酒屋風格的配菜）套餐，一邊小酌一杯。您也可以點菜，並從各種串燒和日本小吃中進行選擇。這家釜山分店是由橫森主廚開設的，他也是首爾新沙洞人氣餐廳Mozu的老闆。

[招牌菜單]
otsumami（小點心）套餐、馬鈴薯沙拉、dashimaki tamago（煎蛋捲）、tataki kyuuri（碎黃瓜沙拉）、oshinko moriawase（什錦日本泡菜）、daikon sarada（蘿蔔沙拉）、negi toro maki（壽司金槍魚丁配蔥）、sunagimo（砂囊）、nanks、s（砂） seseri（烤雞頸）、tebasaki（炸雞翅）、momo（餃子）、烏龍麵、蕎麥麵（日本蕎麥麵）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Donggyeong bapsang
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:30 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. (Last order 8:30 p.m.) - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in rice topped with grilled eel, which are available in Tokyo-style unaju and Nagoya-style hitsumabushi. After eating some of the rice and eel, you can finish it as ochazuke (green tea over rice), which is characteristic of hitsumabshi

[Signature Menu]
donggyeongsik minmul jangeo deopbap (Tokyo-style stirfried eel with rice (unaju)) , nagoyasik minmul jangeo deopbap (Nagoya style stir-fried eel with rice (hitsumabushi)), minmul jangeo deopbap (stir-fried eel with rice)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳的特色是烤鰻魚飯，有東京風格的鰻魚和名古屋風格的鰻魚飯。吃完一些米飯和鰻魚後，您可以將其作為日三吃的特色茶泡飯（茶泡飯）來完成

[招牌菜單]
東京食minmul jangeo deopbap（東京式炒鰻魚飯（unaju））、名古屋minmul jangeo deopbap（名古屋式炒鰻魚飯（hitsumabushi））、minmul jangeo deopbap（炒鰻魚飯）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Sandong Wantang gyojagwan
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This is a place where you can enjoy wontons and dumplings at a reasonable price, and you can experience the flavors of mainland China. The dishes and anju (side dishes for drinking) arereasonably priced, making it an excellent place for a drink. The mapo tofu (tofu and minced meat in a spicy sauce) and eggplant dishes are highly recommended.

[Signature Menu]
wonton soup, gogi mandu (meat mandu), kimchi mandu, mul mandu (boiled mandu), samsaek modum mandu (tricolor mandu), gajiyori (eggplant), tomato gyeran bokkeum (stir-fried tomato and egg), ohyang jangyuk (five-spice pork), mapa dubu (spicy bean curd)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這裡是您可以以合理的價格享用餛飩和餃子，體驗中國大陸風味的地方。菜餚和酒飲的價格都很合理，是個喝酒的好地方。強烈推薦麻婆豆腐（豆腐和肉末）和茄子菜餚。

[招牌菜單]
餛飩湯，gogi mandu（肉mandu），泡菜mandu，mul mandu（水煮mandu），samsaek modum mandu（三色mandu），gajiyori（茄子），番茄gyeran bokkeum（炒番茄和雞蛋），ohyang jangyuk（五香豬肉），mapa bokkeum（炒番茄和雞蛋），ohyang jangyuk（五香豬肉），mapadubudubu

visit_busan_100.award: Visit Busan 官方百大精選 (0 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: BUSAN
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. (Last order 9:30 p.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This modern Chinese restaurant is decorated black tones. The signature dish is Peking duck with crispy skin, made properly in a dedicated wood-fired oven. They also serve a variety of familiar Chinese dishes with a modern twist. Two unique dishes that are noteworthy are their ma-yi-shang-shu (spicy fried cellophane noodles and ground pork) and suan-nibai-rou (pork with spicy garlic sauce).

[Signature Menu]
sacheonsik baechujjim (Sichuan braised napa cabbage), chashu, maui sangsu (spicy fried cellophane noodles and ground pork), sannibaegyuk (garlic pork on a bed of thin-sliced cucumber), dim sum, Peking duck, lunch set, dinner set
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家現代中餐廳以黑色為主色裝飾。招牌菜是皮脆的北京烤鴨，在專用的燃木烤箱中精心製作。他們還提供各種熟悉的具有現代風味的中式菜餚。兩道值得注意的獨特菜餚是麻一尚書（辣炒玻璃紙麵條和肉末）和蒜泥白肉（辣蒜醬豬肉）。

[招牌菜單]
sacheonsik baechujjim（四川紅燒大白菜）、chashu、maui sangsu（辣炒玻璃紙麵條和豬肉末）、sannibaegyuk（蒜蓉豬肉配薄黃瓜片）、點心、北京烤鴨、午餐套餐、晚餐套餐

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Mimiru
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:30 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. (Last order 9:00 p.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.theme_tag: A Culinary World Tour in Busan
visit_busan_100.description:
This Chinese restaurant is a popular spot in Busan. You can enjoy great Chinese food at a reasonable price. One outstanding item on the menu is the Sichuan laziji (mala chicken), which features a harmonious blend of spicy flavors and ingredients. All dishes come topped with a fried egg.

[Signature Menu]
jjajangmyeon (noodles in black bean sauce), jjamppong (spicy seafood noodle soup), junghwa deopbap (chinese bibimbap), sacheon laziji (Sichuan spicy stir-fried chicken), yuringi (deep-fried chicken in hot and sour soy sauce), gungbogijeong (kung pao chicken), menbosha (fried shrimp sandwich), tangsuyuk (deep-fried pork with sweet and sour sauce)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家中餐廳是釜山的熱門場所。您可以以合理的價格享用美味的中國菜。菜單上的特色菜餚是四川辣子雞（麻辣雞），其特點是辛辣口味和配料的和諧融合。所有菜餚均配有煎蛋。

[招牌菜單]
jjajangmyeon（豆豉麵）、jjamppong（辣海鮮湯麵）、junghwa deopbap（中式拌飯）、sacheon laziji（四川辣炒雞）、yuringi（酸辣炸雞）、gungbogijeong（宮保雞丁）、menbosha（炸蝦三明治）、切肉）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Tambok
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:30 - 3:00 p.m. | SAT, SUN 10:30 - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 7:30 p.m. - closed every Monday and Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This abalone restaurant offers a luxurious dining experience. The basic set includes abalone rice, abalone porridge, and grilled abalone. You can choose between miyeok (seaweed), hijiki seaweed, and gondre (Korean thistle) as a garnish for the abalone rice and mix in some gewoo sauce (a sauce made with abalone innards) and abalone paste.

[Signature Menu]
ttalgi mille-feuille (strawberry mille-feuille), tarte chocolat, orange cocoa madeleine, muhwagwa keurimchijeu financier (fig butter cream cheese financier), Haenam bamgoguma crème brulée (sweet potato crème brulée), Americano, caffe latte
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家鮑魚餐廳提供奢華的用餐體驗。基本套餐包括鮑魚飯、鮑魚粥和烤鮑魚。您可以選擇 miyeok（海藻）、hijiki 海藻和 gondre（韓國薊）作為鮑魚飯的裝飾，並混合一些 gewoo 醬（一種用鮑魚內臟製成的醬）和鮑魚醬。

[招牌菜單]
ttalgi mille-feuille（草莓千層酥）、塔特巧克力、橙子可可瑪德琳、muhwagwa keurimchijeu financier（無花果黃油奶油乳酪金融家）、Haenam bamgoguma crème brulée（紅薯焦糖布丁）、美式咖啡、拿鐵咖啡

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Mujinjang hoetjip
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This is a long-standing restaurant that serves anago (conger eel). Try the dried anago sashimi, which is best enjoyed dipped in makjang (fermented soybean-and-barley sauce). The spicy maeuntang (spicy fish soup) that comes with the anago sashimi is also tasty. The restaurant is located in a scenic spot overlooking the sea and offers stunning views.

[Signature Menu]
bungjangeo hoe (sliced raw conger eel), modum hoe (assorted sliced raw fish), dodari (ridged-eye flounder), chamgajami (flouder), dom (sea bream), maeuntang (spicy fish stew)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這是一家經營海鰻的老字號餐廳。嚐嚐乾鰻魚生魚片，最好蘸著makjang（發酵大豆大麥醬）享用。搭配星鰻生魚片的辣魚湯也很美味。餐廳位於風景優美的地方，俯瞰大海，享有壯麗的景色。

[招牌菜單]
bungjangeo hoe（生海鰻片）、modum hoe（什錦生魚片）、dodari（脊目比目魚）、chamgajami（比目魚）、dom（鯛魚）、maeuntang（辣燉魚）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Yeongnam dwaeji
visit_busan_100.hours: 1st floor: 11:30 a.m. a.m. - 10:30 p.m. (Last seating: 9:30,Last order: 10:00 a.m.)
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant offers a variety of high-quality grilled beef and pork. The meat is grilled to perfection for you, so you can enjoy your meal without any hassle. Seasoned green onions and mel-jeot (salted anchovies) are also served with the meat, and make for a delicious combination. A popular dish is mul-naengmyeon, noodles in a chilled, savory broth with a meaty flavor.

[Signature Menu]
samgyeop loseu (grilled pork belly), samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly), moksal (grilled pork shoulder), yangnyeom samgyeomn loseu (grilled marinated pork belly), hangjeongsal (grilled pork neck), mul naengmyeon (cold buckwheat noodles), bibim naengmyeon (spicy buckwheat noodles), chadol doenjang (beef brisket soybean paste jjigae)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳提供各種高品質的烤牛肉和豬肉。肉是為您烤得恰到好處，因此您可以毫無麻煩地享用美食。調味蔥和 mel-jeot（鹹鳳尾魚）也與肉一起食用，形成美味的組合。廣受歡迎的菜餚是水冷麵（mul-naengmyeon），這是一種帶有肉味的冷鮮肉湯麵條。

[招牌菜單]
五花肉、五花肉、烤豬肩肉、烤五花肉、烤豬頸肉、涼麵、拌冷麵、茶多醬（牛腩黃豆醬）

visit_busan_100.award: Visit Busan 官方百大精選 (0 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Ajeossi daegutang
visit_busan_100.hours: 7:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. - closed every 2nd & 4th Monday
visit_busan_100.description:
Here, the popular dish is daegu-tang, a cod soup with a refreshing broth. It is characterized by the addition of cod heads to give the soup flavor. The side dishes, which include various jangajji (pickled side dishes) and mungae-jeot (salted sea squirts), are delicious. The restaurant is also a favorite of artist Heo Young-man and celebrity Jeong Woo.

[Signature Menu]
daegutang (codfish soup), daegu ppoljjim (braised codfish head)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這裡最受歡迎的菜餚是大邱湯，這是一種湯底清爽的鱈魚湯。特色是添加了鱈魚頭，讓湯的味道更加鮮美。配菜包括各種醃菜和海鞘，非常美味。這家餐廳也是藝術家許英萬和名人正宇的最愛。

[招牌菜單]
大邱湯、大邱鱈魚頭

visit_busan_100.award: Visit Busan 官方百大精選 (0 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Budamyeonok
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m. (Last order 7:30 p.m.) - closed every Monday
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in Pyongyang-style naengmyeon, which are noodles served in a chilled, clean-tasting broth. They normally offer only two dishes: Pyongyang naengmyeon and suyuk (steamed pork), but in winter, they also serve gomtang (ox bone soup) and yukgaejang (spicy beef stew).

[Signature Menu]
soonmemil naengmyeons (cold buckwheat noodles), sari (side order), matbogi hanu suyuk (Korean beef suyuk taster), hanu hanmari kkorisuyuk (boiled Korean oxtail slices), kkori gomtang (oxtail and beef bone soup), yukgaejang (spicy beef soup)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳主打平壤風格的冷面，這是一種用冰涼、味道乾淨的肉湯製成的麵條。他們通常只提供兩種菜餚：平壤冷麵和蒸豬肉，但在冬天，他們還提供gomtang（牛骨湯）和yukgaejang（辣燉牛肉）。

[招牌菜單]
Soonmemil naengmyeons（冷蕎麥麵），sari（配菜），matbogi hanu suyuk（韓國牛肉suyuk品嚐），hanu hanmari kkorisuyuk（煮韓國牛尾片），kkori gomtang（牛尾牛骨湯），yukgaejang（辣湯）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Geodae sutbulgui
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant offers high-quality 1++ grade Korean beef in a luxurious setting. Their specialty is yangnyeom-galbi (marinated short ribs), but they also serve a variety of other cuts, such as short ribs, eye filet, and outside skirt. The regular side dishes are usually tasty, and the Pyongyang naengmyeon is great for refreshing your palate.

[Signature Menu]
hanu yangnyeom galbi (grilled marinated Korean galbi), ansim (grilled tenderloin), galbitsal (grilled boneless galbi), deungsim (grilled sirloin), anchangsal (grilled thin skirt), Pyeongyang naengmyeon (pyeongyang cold buckwheat noodles), gomtang (beef bone soup), jeomsim teukseon (lunch special)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳在豪華的環境中提供高品質的 1++ 級韓國牛肉。他們的特色菜是“yangnyeom-galbi”（醃製小排骨），但他們也提供各種其他切法，如小排骨、眼排和外裙。常規的配菜通常都很美味，平壤冷麵非常適合提神味蕾。

[招牌菜單]
hanu yangnyeom galbi（烤醃韓式排骨）、ansim（烤裡肌肉）、galbitsal（烤無骨排骨）、deungsim（烤牛腩）、anchangsal（烤薄裙）、平壤冷麵（平壤冷蕎麥麵）、gomtang（牛骨湯）、jeomsim teuks（午餐特價）特價

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Chopilsal dwaejigui
visit_busan_100.hours: 5:00 p.m. - 01:00 a.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This is a popular grilled pork restaurant in Haeundae. Its flavorful, chewy meat pairs well with the green onions and sauce. The signature dish is the honeycomb-cut pork rinds. They offer a very satisfying meal for the price.

[Signature Menu]
kkeopdegi (pork rinds), sogeum gui (salt-grilledmeat), dwaeji galbi (grilled pork galbi), dwitgogi (various pork cuts), daepae samgyeopsal (grilled thin-sliced pork belly), tongsamgyeop kimchi jjigae (pork and kimchi jjigae)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這是海雲台很受歡迎的烤豬肉餐廳。肉質鮮美、耐嚼，與蔥和醬汁搭配得很好。招牌菜是蜂窩切豬皮。他們以這個價格提供非常令人滿意的一餐。

[招牌菜單]
kkeopdegi（豬皮）、sogeum gui（鹽烤肉）、dwaeji galbi（烤豬肉 galbi）、dwitgogi（各種豬肉切塊）、daepae samgyeopsal（烤薄片五花肉）、tongsamgyeop kimchi jjigae（豬肉和泡菜 jjigae）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Saechong hoetjip
visit_busan_100.hours: 2:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m. - closed every 1st Monday & 3rdSunday
visit_busan_100.description:
Here, you can enjoy ishigari (roughscale sole) sashimi, which is known for its savory, fatty flavor. Other wild-caught fish are also available, so you can enjoy sashimi of various high-quality fish such as domi (sea bream) and gajami (sole). Enjoy the rich-flavored maeuntang (spicy fish soup), which is served afterward.

[Signature Menu]
jayeonsan hoe (sliced raw wild fish), isigari(roughscale sole)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在這裡，您可以品嚐到以其鮮美肥美的味道而聞名的石蒜（粗鱗鰈魚）生魚片。另外還有其他野生魚類，可以品嚐鯛魚、鰈目魚等各種優質魚類的生魚片。隨後享用味道濃鬱的maeuntang（辣魚湯）。

[招牌菜單]
jayeonsan hoe（切片生野生魚），isigari（粗鱗鰈魚）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Dongbaekseom hoetjip
visit_busan_100.hours: 10:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. (Last order 8:20 p.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This wild-caught sashimi restaurant is a local favorite because their fish is so fresh. When you order sashimi, you are also served a variety of seafood and tempura. In Busan, it is customary to dip sashimi in ssamjang (soybean paste), and you can make sushi by placing sashimi on sushi rice. They serve maeuntang (spicy fish soup) and steamed fish as part of your meal.

[Signature Menu]
jeomsim teukseon hoe jeongsik (lunch special sliced raw fish set), hoe course (sliced raw fish full-course set menu), sekkosi (bone-in sliced raw fish)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家野生生魚片餐廳深受當地人喜愛，因為他們的魚非常新鮮。當您點生魚片時，也會為您提供各種海鮮和天婦羅。在釜山，人們習慣將生魚片沾上大醬，而生魚片放在壽司飯上就可以製作壽司了。他們提供maeuntang（辣魚湯）和蒸魚作為餐點的一部分。

[招牌菜單]
jeomsim teukseon hoe jeongsik（午餐特製生魚片套餐），hoe course（生魚片全套套餐），sekkosi（帶骨生魚片）

visit_busan_100.award: Visit Busan 官方百大精選 (0 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Eunhae galchi
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 3:00 p.m. / 5:00 p.m. - 9:00 p.m. (Last order 8:00 p.m.) - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in fresh Jeju kalchi(hairtail) dishes. When you order extra-large grilled kalchi, the pieces are thick and the size of your hand, and have an exquisite texture that is firm and tender. The kalchi-jjigae (hairtail stew) with a doenjang (soybean paste) base has a light and refreshingly spicy taste and is also popular. The side dishes, along with three kinds of salted fish, that they serve are also delicious and neat.

[Signature Menu]
galchi gui (braised cutlassfish), galchi jjigae (cutlassfishjjigae), galchi jorim(braised cutlassfish)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳主打新鮮的濟州帶​​魚菜餚。點特大號的烤卡爾基，厚如手掌大小，口感細膩，緊實細嫩。以大醬為底的帶魚湯，味道清淡爽口，辣味十足，也很受歡迎。他們提供的配菜以及三種鹹魚也非常美味和整潔。

[招牌菜單]
galchi gui（紅燒帶魚）、galchi jjigae（帶魚jjigae）、galchi jorim（紅燒帶魚）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 2 Ribbons (藍絲帶 2 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Eonyang bulgogi busanjip
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 9:30 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in Eonyang-style bulgogi, which is made with thinly sliced highquality beef that is marinated in a unique Eonyang seasoning and then grilled over charcoal. The taste is exquisite, and it is best enjoyed wrapped in the white kimchi that is served with it.

[Signature Menu]
Eonyang bulgogi, deungsim (grilled sirloin), saeng galbitsal (grilled boneless galbi), yuk sashimi (sliced raw beef)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳主打彥陽式烤肉，採用切成薄片的優質牛肉，用獨特的彥陽調味料醃製，然後在木炭上烤。味道很精緻，最好裹上白泡菜一起享用。

[招牌菜單]
Eonyang bulgogi、deungsim（烤牛腰肉）、saeng galbitsal（烤無骨排骨）、yuk sashimi（生牛肉片）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Samo bulgogi
visit_busan_100.hours: 5:30 p.m. - 10:30 p.m. - closed every 1st & 3rd Wednesday
visit_busan_100.description:
This meat restaurant offers two dishes: thinly sliced pork belly and seasoned pork ribs. It also serves a variety of side dishes that go well with the meat, as well as sikhye (sweet rice punch) for dessert. The seasoned crab is a popular side dish. This is a place where you can enjoy a meal at an affordable price.

[Signature Menu]
samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家肉類餐廳提供兩種菜餚：薄片五花肉和調味排骨。它還提供各種與肉類搭配的配菜，以及作為甜點的sikhye（甜米潘趣酒）。調味蟹是一道很受歡迎的配菜。這是一個可以以實惠的價格享用美食的地方。

[招牌菜單]
五花肉（烤五花肉）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Ssangdungi dwaejigukbap
visit_busan_100.hours: 9:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in dwaeji-gukbap(pork soup with rice) and is so popular that there is often a line out the door. Rice is placed in an earthenware pot, and then the soup is poured over it and removed multiple times before serving. The soup is best enjoyed by adding plenty of jeongguji(seasoned Chinese chives). The suyuk (boiled pork) made with hanjoengsal (pork jowl) is also recommended.

[Signature Menu]
dwaeji gukbap (pork soup with rice), naejang gukbap (offal and rice soup), suyuk baekban (boiled pork slices set menu), dwaeji suyuk (boiled pork slices), naejang suyuk (boiled offal slices)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳專營豬肉湯飯，非常受歡迎，門外經常排隊。將米飯放入砂鍋中，然後將湯倒在上面，並在食用前多次取出。汤里加入大量的韭菜，味道更佳。还推荐用猪下肉制作的水煮猪肉。

[招牌菜單]
豬肉湯飯、內臟湯飯、水煮豬肉片套餐、水煮豬肉片、內臟水煮片

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Gijangson kalguksu
visit_busan_100.hours: 9:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. - closed on Lunar New Year's Day and Harvest Moon Day
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant specializes in Gyeongsang-do style kalguksu (handmade noodle soup), served in anchovy broth and topped with crown daisy and Chinese chives. It is light and refreshing, with a hint of sesame seeds and minced garlic. The noodles are made by rolling out the dough, and the only side dish is kkakdugi (radish kimchi). The dish is simple, but generously portioned, with a homemade taste.

[Signature Menu]
son kalguksu (handmade noodle soup), bibim sonkalguksu(spicy handmade noodles), naeng kalguksu (cold handmade noodle soup), gimbap
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳主打慶尚道風格的刀切麵（手工麵條湯），配上鯷魚湯，上面撒上皇冠雛菊和韭菜。它清淡爽口，帶有一絲芝麻和蒜末的味道。麵條是用麵團擀成的，唯一的配菜是 kkakdugi（蘿蔔泡菜）。這道菜很簡單，但份量很大，有家常的味道。

[招牌菜單]
手工刀麵、拌飯 手工辣麵、冷刀麵、海苔包飯

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Hapcheon gukbapjip
visit_busan_100.hours: 9:00 a.m. - 2:00 p.m. / 2:30 p.m. - 8:30 p.m. - open all year
visit_busan_100.description:
This restaurant serves dwaeji-gukbap (pork soup with rice) that has a clear broth. When you order dwaeji-gukbap, the broth is poured over pork innards, such as intestines and uterus, several times before serving. Different variations of gukbap are available, all with rice on the side: modeum ddaro (with assorted meat (pork, sundae, and pork intestines)); sundae ddaro (with Korean sausage); naejang ddaro (with pork intestines); or ddaro (with only pork). It is best enjoyed with plenty of chives as is the custom in Busan.

[Signature Menu]
ttaro gukbap (rice and soup), suyuk baekban (boiled pork slices set menu), suyuk (boiled pork slices), modum suyuk (assorted boiled pork slices), sundae (Korean sausage)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
這家餐廳供應清湯的“dwaeji-gukbap”（豬肉湯飯）。當您點Dwaeji-gukbap時，肉湯會在食用前多次倒在豬肉內臟（例如腸子和子宮）上。有不同的 gukbap 可供選擇，都配有米飯：modeum ddaro（配什錦肉（豬肉、聖代和豬腸））；聖代ddaro（配韓國香腸）； naejang ddaro（配豬腸）；或 ddaro （僅含豬肉）。按照釜山的習俗，最好搭配大量韭菜。

[招牌菜單]
ttaro gukbap（米和湯）、suyuk baekban（水煮肉片套餐）、suyuk（水煮肉片）、modum suyuk（什錦水煮肉片）、聖代（韓國香腸）

visit_busan_100.award: 2027 Blue Ribbon Survey 1 Ribbon (藍絲帶 1 條絲帶)
visit_busan_100.name: Eunha galbi
visit_busan_100.hours: 11:00 a.m. - 10:00 p.m. - closed every 2nd Tuesday
visit_busan_100.description:
At this restaurant, you can have dwaeji-galbi (porkshort ribs), moksal (pork neck), and samgyeopsal(pork belly). It is neither big nor fancy; however, the side dishes and meat are delicious, so it's always full of customers. The pork ribs marinated in homemade seasoning are the most popular dish on the menu.

[Signature Menu]
yangnyeom galbi (grilled marinated galbi), dwaeji moksal (grilled pork shoulder), saeng galbi (grilled galbi), samgyeopsal (grilled pork belly), doenjang jjigae (soybean paste jjigae)
visit_busan_100.description_zh:
在這家餐廳，您可以品嚐到 dwaeji-galbi（豬排）、moksal（豬頸肉）和 samgyeopsal（五花肉）。它既不大也不豪華；不過，小菜和肉都很美味，所以總是擠滿了顧客。用自製調味料醃製的排骨是菜單上最受歡迎的菜餚。

[招牌菜單]
